articles.title: Soul of the West
articles.summary: An interlude following the first novel, narrated by Becca Litland as an address to her missing friend. Negotiations between House Litland and the western Count Reis at the Lacey estate end in a treacherous massacre, which Becca unwittingly disrupts.

articles.title: Fantasies
articles.ru: "Fantasies" - the author's collection of stories around the world "Polari"
articles.summary: A collection of standalone stories written after the completion of the series. According to the author, these are not a continuation of the plot but fantasies about how the lives of particular people might unfold.

articles.title: Voice of Winter
articles.ru: "The Voice of Winter" - Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 11)
articles.summary: An interlude about Erwin Origin during the first months of Minerva's reign: he learns to wield his ancestral sword, Voice of Winter, investigates Adrian's death, and prepares a trap for the Puppeteer, only for the empress's mercy to undo it.

articles.title: He Who Speaks with God
articles.ru: "Speaking to God" - Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 7)
articles.summary: An interlude about the winter journey of shipwrecked northern sailors, the kair Jemis Lilliday, and Mark the Raven through the lands of the Origins, and about how a captured bracelet-Object begins to speak in the voice of a mysterious ‘god’.

articles.title: I Want a Pony
articles.ru: "I Want a Pony" - Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 12)
articles.summary: An interlude about the young hostage Laura Farway in the castle of Priarch Gallard Almera, where a girl accustomed to being ‘good’ in everything survives in a world of intrigue and ultimately betrays her own brother.

articles.title: The Confidante
articles.ru: "Confident" - the interlude of the cycle "Polars"
articles.summary: A side interlude about love and ecclesiastical intrigue: the abbess of a provincial convent, who by all indications is the future Archmother Ellina; Darius Hightower, an emissary of the church court; and Rose Wingrem, a young woman trying to save her seminarian lover.

articles.title: A Doll on the Throne
articles.ru: "A Doll on the Throne" - the third novel of the cycle "Polars"
articles.summary: The third novel in the series: after the North's victory, young Minerva is crowned empress, but real power lies with Lord Chancellor Erwin Origin. The ‘doll’ learns to rule, while Erwin, posing as a conceited rake, sets a trap for the mysterious Puppeteer.

articles.title: Only One Star
articles.summary: The second novel in the Polari series, in two volumes. It covers Erwin Origin's Northern War against Emperor Adrian, from the ultimatum to the capture of the capital, and ends with Adrian's death and Minerva's accession to the throne.

articles.title: Humans and Gods
articles.ru: Humans and Gods is the fifth novel in the Polari series.
articles.summary: The fifth novel in the series: the war against the Puppeteer in Almera, Waymar, and the Steppe; the return of Countess Sybil Northwood's memory; the appearance of Navi, the ‘god of navigation’; and the mystery of Paul's origins.

articles.title: The Skyship and the Girl
articles.ru: "The Skyship and the Girl" - Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 6)
articles.summary: An interlude about the Laem procurer Onoriko-Maysor and the mysterious northern merchant Horam, who buys the headstrong Shavan woman Niza at a slave auction and becomes captivated by the dream of a balloon.

articles.title: Crybaby
articles.summary: An interlude set after the first novel. Nora, a novice nicknamed Crybaby at the underground convent of Ulyana the Sorrowful, meets the half-dead newcomer Mia—Minerva, who has been imprisoned there—and escapes to freedom thanks to her.

articles.title: Useful People
articles.ru: Useful People: The Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 8)
articles.summary: An interlude about Moger Buckley, a cynical agent of Duke Maurice Labelin, who gathers information for his master in Faunterra and is tasked with finding the thief of the Radiant Sphere: the merchant Harmon.

articles.title: Arrow, Coin, Spark (Collector's Edition)
articles.ru: "Arrow, Coin, Spark" with comments by Lady Karen - Collector's Edition
articles.summary: A special edition of the first novel, released to coincide with its publication in print: each chapter is followed by Lady Karen's caustic remarks, correcting the author's ‘historical inaccuracies’, adding details about the world, and recounting arguments with her husband.
searchAliases: «Стрела, монета, искра» с комментариями леди Карен — коллекционное издание

articles.title: Arrow, Coin, Spark
articles.summary: The first novel in the Polari series: the merchant Harmon transports a Sacred Object for sale, the Origin heir Erwin sets out on an explorada beyond the River, and the orphaned Minerva of Stagfort searches for conspirators at court under an assumed name. The book ends with Erwin becoming duke and deciding to overthrow the emperor.

articles.title: Those We Forgive
articles.ru: "Those We Forgive" - the interlude of the cycle "Polars"
articles.summary: An interlude set at Minerva's court in the spring of 1775. Through the eyes of servants and guardsmen, it shows the empress learning to forgive: the lady-in-waiting Leila Talmir, General Smile, and the murderer Inzhi Price.

articles.title: The Shadow of the Great Tree
articles.ru: The Shadow of the Great Tree is the sixth and final novel in the Polari series.
aliases: The Shadow of the Great Tree
articles.summary: The final novel in the series: the campaign of Paul's horde, the Puppeteer's ‘resurrection’, the Battle for First Winter on the Day of the Descent in 1775, and the revelation of the Star's secret, ending with the empress's choice left open.
searchAliases: «Тень Великого Древа» — шестой, заключительный роман цикла «Полари»

articles.title: Now You Are a Sorcerer
articles.ru: "Now You're a Magician" - Interlude of the Polari cycle
articles.summary: A flashback interlude set in 1756: Mik, an orphan from the Waymar library, meets a strange young man named Nathaniel, who calls himself a sorcerer and awakens the Sacred Objects in the cathedral.

articles.title: The Price of Fear
articles.ru: “The price of fear” — the posthuman of the Polari cycle
articles.summary: A flashback novella set in 1756 about the young Vittor Shayland: during the celebrations of the Seventeenth Gift, he secretly watches the rulers swear to conceal the dead goddess from the Gift's resting place, buys his life through fear, and makes the badly burned savage Paul his debtor.

articles.title: The Gates of Trust
articles.ru: "The Gates of Trust" - Interlude of the Polari Cycle (Chapter 10)
articles.summary: An interlude in which the prophet-king Francis-Ilian, accompanied by a filthy beggar who turns out to be the jester Manson, undergoes the trials of the ‘gates of trust’ at the court of the Lady in the Dark in Darkwater.

articles.title: The Yanmei Hunt
articles.ru: “Janmei Hunt” is the fourth novel of the Polari series.
articles.summary: The fourth novel in the series: Erwin and Minerva pursue a shared yet rivalrous hunt for the Puppeteer, the jester Manson stands trial in the Chamber, the merchant Harmon flies over the Bottomless Abyss with the Radiant Sphere, and the ending reveals that Emperor Adrian is alive.

articles.title: The Bishop's Christmas Tree
articles.ru: Bishop's Christmas Tree - Interlude of the Polari Cycle
articles.summary: A Christmastide interlude set in 1748: two boys who sneak into the bishop's garden to get a Christmas tree uncover a plot against the burgomaster.

articles.title: Adamar
articles.ru: Adamar Suzanne Elizabeth Janmei
articles.summary: Emperor Adrian's cousin and second in line to the throne, a celebrated tournament fighter and keen hunter, simple-hearted and trusting. Minerva suspected him of plotting against the heirs, but he passed her test. In late May 1774, he died while hunting when he and his horse fell into a ravine and he broke his neck; this murder became one link in the ‘hunt for the heirs’.
searchAliases: сир Адамар Сюзанна Элизабет рода Янмэй

articles.title: Adrian
articles.ru: Adrian Ingrid Elizabeth of Yangmei, Emperor of Polari
articles.summary: Emperor of Polari, a reformer and advocate of the railway. Believed dead in the Beck train disaster, he survived, wandered in the guise of the Hunter, was deposed by the Chamber, and returned as a claimant to the throne. In Fantasies, he dies in November 1776 during the election of the sovereign.
searchAliases: Адриан Ингрид Элизабет рода Янмэй, император Полари

articles.title: Aiden Almera
articles.ru: Aiden Ellis Gwenda of Agatha, Duke of Almera
articles.summary: Duke of Almera and the emperor's chief adviser, the throne's ‘saviour’ during the Jesters' Conspiracy. After his intrigues were exposed, he took refuge in Evergard and died when it was destroyed in 1774.
searchAliases: Айден Эллис Гвенда рода Агаты, герцог Альмера

articles.title: Ivy
articles.ru: Sir Ivey, Knight of the Earl of Wittor Shayland
articles.summary: A knight of Count Vittor Shayland in Waymar. After Iona's rebellion in May 1775, he and Joaquin guarded the count and watched over the captive countess. He was one of the few who knew about Wilhelm's Fingers, but he refused to wear one.
searchAliases: Сир Айви, рыцарь графа Виттора Шейланда

articles.title: Alanis Almera
articles.ru: Alanis Adelia Abigail of Agatha, Lady Almera
articles.summary: Heiress to the Duchy of Almera, the foremost beauty at court, and Adrian's intended bride before the marriage fell through. She survived the destruction of Evergard and became Erwin Origin's ally and lover; later, in Waymar, she poisoned Gallard and the Puppeteer Vittor Shayland and stabbed Paul with a stiletto. She was believed dead after being tortured, but in Fantasies she is alive under the name Mrs Gale.
searchAliases: Аланис Аделия Абигайль рода Агаты, леди Альмера

articles.title: Albert Almera
articles.ru: Albert Adelia Abigail of Agatha, Lord of Almera
articles.summary: Duke Aiden Almera's younger son and the only one of his children to survive 1775. He grew up in Evergard in fear of his uncle the priarch, was betrothed to Laura Farway, and in 1776 became engaged to Evelyn Farway.
searchAliases: Альберт Аделия Абигайль рода Агаты, лорд Альмера

articles.title: Albert Cantor
articles.ru: Judge Albert Cantor, President of the Supreme Court of the Empire of Polari
articles.summary: The elderly president of the Empire's supreme court, who rose to fame after the Jesters' Conspiracy. In May 1775, he presided over Manson's trial and kept a firm grip on the proceedings until the jester's admission confronted him with the question of succession to the throne.
searchAliases: судья Альберт Кантор, председатель верховного суда Империи Полари

articles.title: Albert Vial
articles.ru: Lord Albert Vial
articles.summary: The Crown's minister of finance under Tellurian and Adrian, falsely accused of emptying the treasury. While imprisoned, he became Minerva's tutor in finance and subsequently returned to ministerial office.

articles.title: Alexis Smile
articles.ru: Alexis Francine Lotte of the Sophia family, Baron Smile
articles.summary: General of the imperial spark-equipped army, victorious at Pixie and defeated in Labelin's night battle. A secret agent of the Lady in the Dark, he helped Minerva become a true sovereign before siding with Adrian after the latter's return from the dead.
searchAliases: Алексис Франсин Лотта рода Софьи, барон Смайл

articles.title: Arthur Highrock
articles.ru: Arthur Elsa May of the Gloria family, Baron Hyroc, castellans of the castle of the First Winter
articles.summary: An initiated kair, baron, and castellan of First Winter Castle, Duke Desmond Origin's ‘left hand’ and one of his prime vassals. In his youth, as a captain, he guarded the Gift's resting place in Shayland; in 1775, he prepared First Winter's defences and received Empress Minerva at the castle.
searchAliases: Артур Эльза Мей рода Глории, барон Хайрок, кастелян замка Первой Зимы

articles.title: Barney
articles.ru: Bernard of Leed
articles.summary: A boy from Leed, Captain Hyder Leed's nephew, carried off into slavery by the Shavans. In Fantasies, he is sold at an altessa auction in Laem, secretly bought as part of Princess Demetra's scheme to test her fiancé, and returned to his uncle. He later becomes a spark engineer.

articles.title: Baron Esher
articles.ru: Baron Escher, Mayor of Faunterra
articles.summary: Burgomaster of Faunterra under Adrian. In December 1774, when the northerners seized the palace, he took the Dynasty's Objects by train to Marengo, and they were stolen on the journey. Erwin dismissed him, and Esher fled to Darkwater, remaining the chief suspect although the Raven of the Crown doubted his guilt.

articles.title: The Barons Devo
articles.ru: Barons Bernard and Reginald Deveaux
articles.summary: Two baronial brothers from the free city of Finborough in the Southern Way, owners of the city's spark machine and the protagonists of ‘Routine Business’ in Fantasies. In the summer of 1776, the younger brother, Reginald, murdered the elder, Bernard, hid his body in a drainpipe, and arranged for the dog Biter, which had discovered the corpse, to stand trial.

articles.title: Benjamin Womack
articles.ru: Sir Benjamin Womack
articles.summary: A minor knight of the Southern Way who stopped Harmon's caravan in the spring of 1774, mocked the travellers, and was wounded by Joaquin Eve Hannah in a duel.

articles.title: Burke
articles.ru: Burke, mercenary and rogue, "squire" Joaquin
articles.summary: A ferret-faced mercenary, card player, and rogue, and an old friend of Joaquin. In Only One Star, he became Joaquin's ‘squire’, helped him rescue the wounded Alanis from burning Evergard, and stayed behind to cover her escape from Blackmore Castle. He was later captured by the priarch's men and burned as a heretic in Aleridan.

articles.title: Blackberry
articles.ru: Colonel Blackberry
articles.summary: An elderly colonel from First Winter, one of the ‘foremost commanders of the land of Origin’, a former commander of the mountain guard, and Richard Origin's mentor. During the Northern War, Erwin made him the army's ‘provider’. In 1775, he led a battalion of ‘Father's landing force’ to Waymar, where he failed to recognise the returned Richard, and later held the line in the Battle for First Winter.

articles.title: Brant Steel
articles.ru: Kair Brant Steel
articles.summary: An Origin kair from a family of shepherds, Damon Origin's assistant and friend, runner-up in the tournament at Doyle, and one of the six duelists who won victory for the northerners outside Labelin. He died defending the palace in Faunterra while leading a night sortie against the stone-throwers.

articles.title: Brother Ludwig
articles.ru: brother Ludwig of Maximian Monastery, aka Tramp
articles.summary: A corpulent monk of the Maximian monastery outside Labelin and an agent of the secret order of Gardeners. In 1774, he served as the kidnapped Harmon's jailer and interrogator, took away the genuine Radiant Sphere, and pursued the merchant's party, killing Doxett and wounding Whirlwind. In the winter of 1775, under the name Wanderer and the guise of a former brewer, he became an adviser to the Snowdrops' leader Salem and, in Joaquin's view, pushed the uprising towards war.
searchAliases: брат Людвиг из Максимиановского монастыря, он же Бродяга

articles.title: Brother Marius
articles.ru: Marius the physician from the monastery of Marek and Simeon
articles.summary: A monk and healer from the monastery of Marek and Simeon in northern Almera, formerly a regimental physician of the Lady in the Dark. In September 1774, he saved the wounded Alanis Almera, brought to him by Joaquin, from blood poisoning and later helped her leave the monastery in secret.
searchAliases: Брат-лекарь Мариус из обители Марека и Симеона

articles.title: Chara
articles.ru: Chara Without Fear (The Companion)
articles.summary: A Shavan archer, one of the ‘Companions’, and Neimir's partner and lover for five years. She maimed Moran, turned bandit with the Sorcerer, served Adrian in his guise as the Hunter, and then became one of Paul's three ‘blades’ and an instructor of the khanids. She was killed in the Roe Deer Grotto during the Battle for First Winter.

articles.title: Charlie the Calf
articles.ru: Charlie the calf, who appeared in the army of Charlie the Bull
articles.summary: A tanner's son who joined the Snowdrops' army. A member of Dodge's hand-picked hundred, he fired a spark weapon at Joaquin during Salem's arrest; that night, at gunpoint, he helped Joaquin kill the guards around the wagon in which Salem was being held.
searchAliases: Чарли Теленок, назвавшийся в войске Чарли Быком

articles.title: Dallia Raven
articles.ru: Dallia Raven, Ghost of the Castle, The First Winter
articles.summary: A young female ghost from First Winter Castle who served the spirit of Odar the Haughty for many years before becoming Erwin Origin's ‘altessa Anxiety’, invisible to everyone else. Her true name is revealed in Fantasies.
searchAliases: Даллия Рейвен, призрак замка Первая Зима

articles.title: Darius Hightower
articles.ru: Darius Hightower, emissary of the Church Court of the Church of Pram
articles.summary: A stern emissary of the ecclesiastical court of the Church of the Foremothers and Rose Wingrem's unwilling fiancé in The Confidante. He sentenced her lover to death, but the abbess's blackmail forced him to cancel both the execution and the wedding.
searchAliases: Дариус Хайтауэр, эмиссар церковного суда Праматеринской Церкви

articles.title: Grandfather
articles.ru: Grandfather (retired judge from the North, real name hidden by vow)
articles.summary: A retired northern judge who has relinquished his former name, fond of parables and playing the chimbuk. At Erwin Origin's behest, he accompanied Mark the Raven on investigations and became the head of the Protection's assistant.
searchAliases: Дед (отставной судья с Севера, настоящее имя скрыто обетом)

articles.title: Damon Origin
articles.ru: Damon Emilia Gerda
articles.summary: Erwin Origin's cousin and Robert's younger brother, a dashing golden-haired kair, commander of the X-cloaks, and the duke's right-hand man in the war of 1774. He died defending the palace in Faunterra.

articles.title: Demetra Nellis-Lyon
articles.ru: Demeter Nellis-Lyon, Infanta Shimmery
articles.summary: One of King Francis-Ilian's sixteen daughters, Prince Hector's sister, and a schoolmate of Iona and Alanis at boarding school. An enterprising Laem trendsetter, promised in marriage to Jemis Lilliday. In Fantasies, she tests her fiancé through an intrigue involving the kidnapped boy Barney, and Jemis breaks off their engagement.

articles.title: Hugo Derrill
articles.ru: Hugo Doris Marta of Leonora, Baron Darryl
articles.summary: A trusted vassal and military commander of Duke Maurice Labelin, a cruel and arrogant baron. He accepted the counterfeit Radiant Sphere from Harmon and issued a bill of exchange for 36,000 hilts, then pursued the merchant for the fraud. He commanded the knights of the Southern Way during Magda Labelin's Shimmery campaign and was among those who helped Adrian regain power after his return from the dead.
searchAliases: Хьюго Дорис Марта рода Леоноры, барон Деррил

articles.title: Desmond Origin
articles.ru: Desmond Gerda Lenore of Agatha, Duke of Origin
articles.summary: The reigning Duke of Origin at the start of the series, a stern commander and the father of Richard, Erwin, and Iona. Stricken with Stone Sickness, he abdicated in Erwin's favour, later returned to active service, and was murdered by his eldest son after the Battle for First Winter.
searchAliases: Десмонд Герда Ленор рода Агаты, герцог Ориджин

articles.title: David Atterton
articles.ru: David Atterton, seminarian
articles.summary: A poor seminarian and Rose Wingrem's beloved. Accused of stealing a Sacred Object, he refuses at his trial to save himself by lying at the altar and is sentenced to hang.

articles.title: Doxett
articles.ru: Doxett
articles.summary: An old, hard-drinking soldier who served the merchant Harmon as a guard and driver for fifteen years. Fond of military yarns, he took part in freeing his master from prison. He died on 4 July 1774 while covering the party's escape from Brother Ludwig's monks.

articles.title: Dorian Ember
articles.ru: Baronet Dorian Amber Janmei
articles.summary: First Secretary of the Imperial Palace Chancery under Minerva. A witty descendant of Yanmei, a womaniser, and Erwin Origin's friend from their student days, he secretly supplied the empress with information but for a long time played into the duke's hands. He later became one of the pillars of her court in First Winter.
searchAliases: баронет Дориан Эмбер рода Янмэй Милосердной

articles.title: Dorcaster
articles.ru: Baron Dorcaster, vassal to the Earl of Shayland
articles.summary: A bald, jovial baron with an egg-shaped head, Count Vittor Shayland's ‘perpetual guest’, whom Mira considered a complete fool. In 1775, he was the only vassal to join the Puppeteer with his full strength: armed with a Finger of Wilhelm, he held Bear's Fang against Craig Northwood, then guarded the captive Iona in Leed, where she burned him with a Finger.

articles.title: Dreyfus Born
articles.ru: Dreyfus Born
articles.summary: Head of the tax service under Adrian and minister of taxation under Lord Chancellor Origin; an embezzler whom Minerva forced to confess by taking his family hostage.

articles.title: Jeff Bamber
articles.ru: Captain Jeff Bamber
articles.summary: Captain of the schooner Seal in Count Fleming's fleet, a sailor's son who dreamed of buying his freedom from his liege. During Fleming's rebellion, his crew alone remained loyal to the Origins; after losing his ship, Bamber led the sailors out on foot through the snow. He was rewarded with the schooner Sea Arrow and carried Duchess Sophia to Folta aboard her in the summer of 1775.

articles.title: Jemis Lilliday
articles.ru: Dames Dorothy Laura of the genus Gloria, Lord Lilliday
articles.summary: A kair of the northern House Lilliday and son of the Snow Count. He once rebelled against Erwin Origin, then became his closest companion, the ‘duke's wolf’, and the operator of the Weapon in the Battle for First Winter.
searchAliases: Джемис Дороти Лаура рода Глории, лорд Лиллидей

articles.title: Jeremy Farway
articles.ru: Lord Jeremy Farway
articles.summary: Duke Henry Farway's grandson and Laura's elder brother, a self-confident freethinker and keen player of Stratems. In the winter of 1774–1775, he lived as a hostage under Priarch Gallard in Evergard. Laura denounced him as a heretic, and he was sentenced to eight years as a novice. In Fantasies, he has married a steppe ganta's daughter for the sake of peace and lives in Rei-Roy.

articles.title: Joaquin Eve Hannah
articles.ru: Joaquin Eve Hannah from Sad Hill
articles.summary: A young warrior from the Southern Way, the son of a modest knight, dreaming of glory and a coat of arms. He serves as the merchant Harmon's guard, Alanis Almera's rescuer and bodyguard, and an adviser to the Snowdrops, then becomes a Finger-bearer and knight of Count Vittor Shayland. The viewpoint character of the ‘Sword’ chapters.
searchAliases: Джоакин Ив Ханна с Печального Холма

articles.title: Joy Hammond
articles.ru: Kire Captain Joy Hammond
articles.summary: A kair of the X-cloaks, an officer of the mountain guard, and commander of Erwin Origin's personal guard during the Northern War. He guarded the captive Alanis Almera and, with her help, led the northerners past an Almeran outpost and captured the Palace of Pen and Sword, where he directed the defence. He died in December 1774 after being struck by a catapult stone; Erwin himself delivered the mercy blow.

articles.title: John Falcon
articles.ru: John Sokolik, the commander of Erwin Origin's mercenary archers
articles.summary: A mercenary archer hired away from his previous employer by Erwin Origin after the Battle of the Wise River, ‘the best archer in the northerners' army’. He commanded the archers during the defence of the Palace of Pen and Sword in Faunterra, was one of only three officers still alive near the end of the siege, and died after receiving a wound to the stomach.
searchAliases: Джон Соколик, командир наёмных лучников Эрвина Ориджина

articles.title: Jonas
articles.ru: Jonas Holi Martin, Duke Ayden Almer's coachman
articles.summary: Duke Aiden Almera's grey-haired coachman, interrogated by the Protection after his master's flight. In trying to protect Alanis, he revealed to Mark the blackmail of the ‘She-Bear's red-haired daughter’. In Fantasies, he is the ‘voice’ of Sir Humphrey's band in Faunterra, announcing to the crowd at the moment of Adrian's death that ‘Yanmei has punished him’.
searchAliases: Джонас Холи Мартин, кучер герцога Айдена Альмера

articles.title: Edgar Flame
articles.ru: Count Edgar Flame (born Edgar Lighthart) of the family of Elena, the ruler of Leonhard
articles.summary: The sombre Count of Leongard, the last son of the disgraced Duke Lightheart, Nexia Flame's father, and commander of Hope's finest regiment; he takes counsel with his pet rat Hartley.
searchAliases: граф Эдгар Флейм (урождённый Эдгар Лайтхарт) рода Елены, властитель Леонгарда

articles.title: Elias Northwood
articles.ru: the Earl of Elias Northwood
articles.summary: The elderly Count of Northwood, head of the Great House Northwood, and Sybil's husband, indifferent to everything except ships. Unaware of the substitution of brides, he refused to support Origin's rebellion and remained an honoured prisoner in Waymar. In 1775, he became a hostage in Shayland's struggle with his own son Craig and ended the war as the Puppeteer's pliant puppet.

articles.title: Alice Cavendish
articles.ru: Alice Cavendish
articles.summary: A physics student at Faunterra University and assistant to Professor Nicholas Ollie, whose sound-recording apparatus she assembled. She is secretly in love with her mentor. The heroine of ‘Fantasy One: The Device’; in ‘Annoying Little Things’, Somerset Flame is unrequitedly in love with her.

articles.title: Ellina
articles.ru: St. Elina, High Priest of the Church of the Foremothers
articles.summary: The Archmother and head of the Church of the Foremothers, originally of the Order of Sophia. In 1756, she is vigorous and stands above worldly games. By 1775, the ninety-year-old Ellina has lost her mental faculties, and Mother Cordelia speaks on her behalf. In Fantasies, she dies on 2 February 1776.
searchAliases: святая архиматерь Эллина, первосвященница Церкви Праматерей

articles.title: Bishop Amessin
articles.ru: Gregor Amessin, Bishop of Aleridana, head of the Combat Brotherhood of the Forefather Wilhelm
articles.summary: Bishop of Aleridan, head of the Fighting Brotherhood of Wilhelm, representative of the Church of the Forefathers in the Chamber, and Priarch Gallard's ‘right hand’. He alone voted against Gallard's deposition at the Ecumenical Council and was an ally of the Puppeteer. In Fantasies, he is the ambassador of the Forefathers' branch in First Winter and a candidate for the priarch's mantle; in the autumn of 1776, he is elected priarch through bribery and soon exposed.
searchAliases: Грегор Амессин, епископ Алеридана, глава Боевого братства Праотца Вильгельма

articles.title: Erwin Origin
articles.ru: Erwin Sophia Jessica of the Lineage of Agatha, Duke of Origin
articles.summary: Duke Desmond's second son, who became ruler of the Great House Origin, leader of the Northern War against Emperor Adrian, and later Lord Chancellor of the Empire of Polari and the Puppeteer's conqueror in the Battle for First Winter. A central protagonist of the series and the viewpoint character of the ‘Arrow’ chapters.
searchAliases: Эрвин София Джессика рода Агаты, герцог Ориджин

articles.title: Philip Lowfert
articles.ru: Philip Doris Laura, Baron Lawfert
articles.summary: A baron and the Crown's imperial observer on Erwin Origin's expedition beyond the River in 1774. A boastful windbag who constantly addressed Erwin as ‘young man’; a remark he made by the River prompted Erwin to cross it. He died in the night massacre at the expedition's camp.

articles.title: Fitzgerald
articles.ru: Kair Lt Fitzgerald
articles.summary: A young kair of the X-cloaks, deputy to Captain Gordon Sue, who took command of Erwin Origin's first pennant company after Gordon was wounded in 1775. Fanatically devoted to the duke, he accompanied him through Reis and the Mills, then north by sea, and fought in the Battle for First Winter. In Fantasies, he joins Scar and Aubrey in hunting a ghost in the Origins' castle.

articles.title: Benedict Fleming
articles.ru: Benedict Miranda Heather of the Gloria family, Earl of Fleming
articles.summary: The devout Count of Belomorye, the foremost vassal of the Origins, who betrayed Erwin first for Adrian and then for Vittor Shayland. He was eventually taken prisoner and frozen alive.
searchAliases: Бенедикт Миранда Хезер рода Глории, граф Флеминг

articles.title: Forlemay
articles.ru: Forlemey, aide to the joker Manson
articles.summary: A nobleman and guardsman whom Tellurian assigned to serve food to the jester Manson. Over sixteen or seventeen years, he became the jester's adjutant and nursemaid rather than merely his guard, survived the Beck train disaster, and testified at the trial about a letter the jester had received in Aleridan. After the trial, Manson hired him as his orderly.

articles.title: Francis-Ilian
articles.ru: Francis-Ilianus of Sophia the Great, King of Shimmery, First of the Five
articles.summary: King of Shimmery, who withdrew from affairs of state to a monastic cell and became famous for his prophetic dreams. A master of the secret order of Gardeners, Manson's defender at his trial, and one of the south's most skilful politicians; after the war, a peacemaker between both branches of the Church and a contender for the priarch's mantle and the imperial throne.
searchAliases: Франциск-Илиан рода Софьи Величавой, король Шиммери, Первый из Пяти

articles.title: Eff
articles.ru: Sir Francis Murray, nicknamed Eph
articles.summary: A nineteen-year-old knight of Count Vittor Shayland who, together with Inzhi Price, took Minerva from the convent and guarded her in Waymar; the secret lover of the maid Lindsey. While helping Mira search for missing girls, he followed her through a secret passage into the cellar of the old convent, where Inzhi killed him in November 1774.
searchAliases: Сир Френсис Мюррей по прозвищу Эф

articles.title: Gallard Almera
articles.ru: Gallard Almera, Priory of the Church of the Forefathers
articles.summary: Head of the Church of the Forefathers and Duke Aiden's elder brother. After the destruction of Evergard, he seized power in Almera, burned heretics, allied himself with Paul, and was killed by Alanis in Waymar.

articles.title: Ganta Birai
articles.ru: Ganta Biray, Shavan from Reis
articles.summary: A Shavan ganta from Reis who abandoned the Companions Neimir and Chara during a battle in Litland. He subsequently robbed banks in the Sorcerer's service, followed the Newcomer-Hunter into Adrian's service, and became commander of the emperor's new personal guard. He attends the sovereign until the end of the series.

articles.title: Ganta Thunderstorm
articles.ru: Ganta Thunderstorm, rider of the Great Steppe, “the Whip of Moran of the Steppe Fire”
articles.summary: A Shavan ganta, slave trader, and Moran Steppe Fire's right-hand man, later the County of Reis's ambassador to the Chamber. He went from being Erwin Origin's enemy to his ally and died fighting at the gates of Rei-Roy.
searchAliases: Ганта Гроза, всадник Великой Степи, «хлыст Морана Степного Огня»

articles.title: Ganta Kort
articles.ru: Ganta Kort, Shavan Chief of Reis
articles.summary: A cunning Shavan ganta whose gan included the Companions Neimir and Chara. He urged them to kill Moran, served under Paul as one of Pus-Ganta's three chief assistants, and, after the southern horde's defeat, led its remnants into Almera and allied himself with Henry Farway. In Fantasies, he rules the Steppe and seeks peace with the North.
searchAliases: Ганта Корт, шаванский вождь из Рейса

articles.title: Harold Greta Lucia
articles.ru: Sir Harold Greta Lucia of the Inesa family, castellans of Waymar Castle
articles.summary: Castellan of Waymar Castle and commander of its garrison, a vassal of Count Vittor Shayland. He brought the count and the merchant Harmon together for the sale of the Radiant Sphere and was the first to die on the night of Iona Origin's coup.
searchAliases: Сир Гарольд Грета Люсия рода Инессы, кастелян Уэймарского замка

articles.title: Harry Hogg
articles.ru: Harry Hogg
articles.summary: Count Vittor Shayland's barber and confidant in Waymar, and Joaquin's friend. He proved to be one of the few people able to use a Finger of Wilhelm. He died on the night of Iona's coup, and Joaquin used his hand to turn the tide of the battle.

articles.title: Hector of Shimmery
articles.ru: Hector Elvira Adelaide of Sophia the Great, Crown Prince of the Shimmery Kingdom
articles.summary: Crown Prince of Shimmery, who effectively rules the kingdom while his father lives as a hermit. Adrian's ally in the war against Steppe Fire, twice defeated by the horde; later Erwin Origin's friend and drinking companion, who refused to fight the kairs.
searchAliases: Гектор Эльвира Аделаида рода Софьи Величавой, наследный принц королевства Шиммери

articles.title: Gerion
articles.ru: Gerion, aide-de-camp to Francis-Iliane
articles.summary: A young southerner from a wealthy family, adjutant to the prophet-king Francis-Ilian. He languished for eight years at the abdicated king's side in a monastery and sold his secrets. In Nen-Clair, he tried to arrange an assassination attempt on the prophet using korzo seeds, was exposed, and was ‘given’ to the Lady in the Dark as a channel for false information.

articles.title: Gloria Northwood
articles.ru: Gloria Sybil Dorina Susan, Lady Northwood
articles.summary: The daughter of Countess Sybil Northwood and, secretly, Priarch Gallard Almera. As part of her mother's scheme, she lived at court under Minerva Stagfort's name and became Emperor Adrian's bride-to-be. After the deception was exposed, she was executed by being walled into the foundations of a gazebo beside the Farewell Temple.
searchAliases: Глория Сибил Дорина рода Сьюзен, леди Нортвуд

articles.title: Gobart-Sintal
articles.ru: Hobart-Synthal, a merchant shipman from Soltown
articles.summary: The wealthiest merchant in Soltown and senior merchant of the Southern Way's Second Maritime Guild. He grew rich through trade with Shimmery and imitated southerners in everything, even his name. He was the first to bargain with Harmon over the Radiant Sphere, raising his offer to thirty-three thousand hilts; in the autumn of 1774, he negotiated with Erwin Origin after the latter captured the city.

articles.title: Gordon Sue Rose
articles.ru: Captain Gordon Sue Rose
articles.summary: Captain of Erwin Origin's first, or pennant, company of X-cloaks, a brave and cheerful tactician. He held the Cliff near Fliss, lost an arm saving the duke at Rei-Roy, captured Richard in the Battle for First Winter, and was killed by him that same night.

articles.title: Hortensius
articles.ru: Master Hortensius of Laem
articles.summary: A master stoker from Laem and inventor of the balloon, the ‘skyship’. With Harmon's money, he built the Double Sphere in Melison, flew with him to the Bottomless Abyss, and helped Adrian in his guise as the Hunter capture the Second of the Five. After losing the vessel, he took his share of the spoils and returned to Laem.

articles.title: Count Rantigar
articles.ru: Earl of Rantigar, ruler of the Sunset Coast
articles.summary: Ruler of the Sunset Coast, who launched the War for the Mills and lost it after the Origins intervened. In the autumn of 1774, he appeared at Adrian's court professing his loyalty, only for the ambassador of Reis to cut his throat in the hall itself. After his death, his two sons and General Oris divided the Sunset Coast.

articles.title: Gurlakh
articles.ru: Gourlakh, Shavan from the detachment of the Ganty of Biray
articles.summary: A Shavan in Ganta Birai's band: a braggart and fierce swordsman who robbed banks with the Sorcerer and later became one of Adrian's guardsmen. In The Shadow of the Great Tree, he seizes Ember and Karen of Arden at the sovereign's command and forcibly makes Manson drink echiota.
searchAliases: Гурлах, шаван из отряда ганты Бирая

articles.title: Gwenda
articles.ru: Gwenda
articles.summary: A prisoner in the mysterious fort beyond the River who has lost her memory; a bearer of firstblood able to speak with Sacred Objects. She died in Leed while trying to free Iona Origin.

articles.title: Hyder Leed
articles.ru: Hyder Leed, captain of the Leed Wolves
articles.summary: Captain of the Leed Wolves company, the finest interrogator and master of sabotage in Erwin Origin's army. Together with the duke, he freed Iona from captivity in Leed.
searchAliases: кайр Хайдер Лид, капитан Лидских Волков

articles.title: Henry Farway
articles.ru: Henry Farway, Duke of Hope
articles.summary: The cunning and calculating ruler of Hope, who received the duchy after the Jesters' Conspiracy. He manoeuvred between the opposing sides throughout the war and ultimately acquired Almera as well.

articles.title: Ingrid
articles.ru: Mistress Ingrid, Empress Polari, Telurian's wife and Adrian's mother
articles.summary: The late empress, wife of Emperor Tellurian and mother of Adrian, a native of Nen-Clair and cousin of the Lady in the Dark. The court initially despised her as a ‘swamp woman’, but she was remembered as a sharp-tongued, intelligent, and profound woman. The Sacred Object called the Drop of the Sun was buried with her and became the Puppeteer's target in 1775.
searchAliases: Владычица Ингрид, императрица Полари, жена Телуриана и мать Адриана

articles.title: Inzhi Price
articles.ru: Inzhi Price nicknamed Couple
articles.summary: A moustachioed chatterbox and former clockmaker who is in fact a hired killer and escaped convict. Mira's jailer and ‘mentor’ in Waymar, who sold her to Martin Shayland; later forgiven by Minerva, he became her loyal agent.

articles.title: Iona Origin
articles.ru: Iona Sophia Jessica of Agatha the Radiant, Countess of Shayland
articles.summary: Duke Desmond Origin's daughter and Erwin's sister, married off to Count Vittor Shayland. She was the first to discover that her husband was the Puppeteer, rebelled against him in Waymar, endured six months of captivity in a dog cage, escaped from Leed with her brother, and became a bearer of firstblood and a healer.
searchAliases: Иона София Джессика рода Светлой Агаты, графиня Шейланд

articles.title: Irving
articles.ru: kair Irving, adjutant and captain of Iona's guard
articles.summary: A kair in Iona Origin's retinue in Waymar: first her adjutant, then captain of her guard after Seymour Steel's fall. He helped Iona investigate the mystery of the castle dungeon's prisoner and, on 27 May 1775, carried her letters and ring to Erwin in Faunterra.
searchAliases: кайр Ирвинг, адъютант и капитан стражи Ионы

articles.title: Ethan Gladys Norma
articles.ru: Ethan Gladys Norma of Faunterra
articles.summary: Emperor Adrian's stammering secretary and a secret agent of the Protection, in love with Minerva. With Mark, he exposed the substitution of the bride and rescued Minerva from Waymar's dungeons; later, at Erwin Origin's command, he was disfigured by the Leed Wolves' torture. In Fantasies, he is Burgomaster Adrian's secretary, wearing a white mask: unnamed in ‘The Device’, but identified by name in ‘Ad-ri-an!’.

articles.title: Karen
articles.ru: Karen Cecily Caitlin Elena, Lady Lighthart (Lady Karen of Arden)
articles.summary: The daughter of the executed Duke Jonas Lightheart, who spent around twenty years in the Faraday-Riley asylum. She escaped with Dorothy and Navi, returned to her husband, the jester Manson, and secretly aided Adrian's opponents.
searchAliases: Карен Сесили Кейтлин рода Елены, леди Лайтхарт (леди Карен Арденская)

articles.title: Catherine Catherine
articles.ru: Lady Catherine Catherine, althessa and consort of Prince Hector of Shimmeria
articles.summary: A western woman from Hollywell, sold to the South, who became the altessa of Prince Hector of Shimmery and later Emperor Adrian's adviser on social intrigue. During the war against Steppe Fire, she returned to Hector, received Adrian's permission to choose a Sacred Object, and later bore the prince a son. In Fantasies, she is Hector's wife and an astute politician.
searchAliases: Леди Катрин Катрин, альтесса и супруга принца Гектора Шиммерийского

articles.title: Haggot
articles.ru: Haggott, Shavan of the Ganty of Biray
articles.summary: A Shavan in Ganta Birai's band. Severely wounded in a bank raid, he narrowly escaped becoming the Sorcerer's victim and tried to stab the Newcomer who had taken his place. Spared by him, Haggot became the Hunter's devoted fighter and later one of Adrian's guardsmen.
searchAliases: Хаггот, шаван из отряда ганты Бирая

articles.title: Halintor
articles.ru: Halintor, Deputy, then Sheriff Laema.
articles.summary: Laem's deputy sheriff, a skilled swordsman and a guardian of the law whose ‘leniency’ came at a price. In 1775, he handled Moger Buckley's case concerning Vanessa-Lilith's disappearance, then hunted the Radiant Sphere on Prince Hector's orders and was captured by the Hunter. In Fantasies, he is Sheriff of Laem and, by all indications, Vanessa-Lilith's lover.
searchAliases: Халинтор, помощник шерифа, затем шериф Лаэма

articles.title: Humphrey
articles.ru: Sir Humphrey Elsa Carina, Lieutenant of the Guard Duke Aiden Almer
articles.summary: A lieutenant in Aiden Almera's guard who carried the wounded Alanis from burning Evergard and covered her escape from Blackmore Castle. In Fantasies, now one-eyed, he poses as one of Adrian's ‘lads’, leads a band in Faunterra, and takes revenge for House Almera's destruction; by all indications, his men kill Adrian.
searchAliases: сир Хамфри Эльза Карина, лейтенант гвардии герцога Айдена Альмера

articles.title: Harmon Paula Roger
articles.ru: Harmon Paula Roger, merchant
articles.summary: An itinerant merchant entrusted by Count Vittor Shayland with secretly selling the Radiant Sphere. He sold Duke Labelin a forgery, escaped south with the genuine Object, and developed from a greedy huckster into the founder of aerial navigation. The main viewpoint character of the ‘Coin’ chapters.

articles.title: Hash Eilish
articles.ru: Hash Eilish of Silens, a messenger of the Sunset Coast
articles.summary: A priestess of the cult of the Fallen One from the Sunset Coast, a pupil of General Horis (Oris). She came to Vittor Shayland as an envoy, witnessed Iona's rebellion, and became Joaquin Eve Hannah's lover. By touch, she could read a person's past and sense approaching death. She survived the Chosen One's campaign against First Winter.
searchAliases: Хаш Эйлиш из Сайленса, посланница Закатного Берега

articles.title: Hawksworth Fellion
articles.ru: Lord Hawksworth Fellion, former Minister of the Court
articles.summary: An elderly man with a lisp, Minister of the Court under Adrian and the ‘soul of the Palace of Pen and Sword’. Dismissed by Minerva when she abolished his ministry, he recreated a replica of the court on his estate in Marengo and invited the lawman Mac to investigate a murder in the vault holding his Sacred Object.
searchAliases: лорд Хоксворт Феллион, бывший министр двора

articles.title: Kid
articles.ru: Kid, Spot Hunter
articles.summary: A cheerful young hunter from Spot, the settlement's foremost expert on the Soft Fields. In the spring of 1774, he guided Erwin Origin's explorada through the marshes, pulled Erwin out of a bog, warned him about the kairs' rebellion, and taught him to treat wounds with snake-grass.

articles.title: Clive Stagfort
articles.ru: Sir Clive Maria Bella, Lord Stagforth
articles.summary: A northern knight of modest means, former captain of the Scarlet Guard, holder of the fief of Stagfort, and father of Empress Minerva. He was killed in an ambush in the Forest Fringe in March 1774; his murder opens the ‘Spark’ storyline.
searchAliases: Сир Клайв Мария Белла, лорд Стагфорт

articles.title: Colemon
articles.ru: Colemon, the hunter from Spot
articles.summary: An elderly, grumbling, superstitious hunter from Spot, senior guide to Erwin Origin's explorada through the Soft Fields in the spring of 1774. A knowledgeable tracker who tried until the last moment to dissuade the lord from crossing the River.

articles.title: Colin Felicia
articles.ru: Colin Felicia Angela of Soltown
articles.summary: A self-assured young assistant to the Southern Way's lord representative in the Chamber; his scenes were removed from the 2026 edition of Arrow, Coin, Spark. In earlier editions, in the summer of 1774, he invited Minerva Stagfort to a demonstration of ‘voice-at-a-distance’ at the University, let slip the balance of power in the Chamber, and, after becoming handsy on the Garden Bridge, was sent away in disgrace.

articles.title: Konto
articles.ru: Mr. Conto, banker, owner of the First Credit Bank
articles.summary: A banker in the capital, owner of First Credit. He suggested that Minerva issue paper banknotes and secretly opened a personal account for her; taxes under the Morlin-May reform passed through his branches. Erwin counted him among ‘Minerva's lackeys’.
searchAliases: Господин Конто, банкир, хозяин банка «Первый кредит»

articles.title: Craig Northwood
articles.ru: Sir Craig Northwood, The Fang Knight
articles.summary: Count Elias Northwood's eldest son and heir, a celebrated tournament fighter. He brought Northwood's army to support Origin's rebellion and served as commander-in-chief of the spark-equipped army. In 1775, he fought his own father over Bear's Fang and died in the night battle at Fox Vale.

articles.title: Croydon Beckfield
articles.ru: Croydon Alicia Megan of the genus Lucia Lupus, Major Backfield
articles.summary: An officer of the Scarlet Guard and head of the Protection under Adrian. He ruthlessly besieged Erwin Origin in the Palace of Pen and Sword, secretly hid Sybil Northwood in an asylum, and handed her over for execution. At the end of the series, he is a colonel and head of Adrian's secret guard.
searchAliases: Кройдон Алисия Мэган рода Лучистой Люсии, майор Бэкфилд

articles.title: Quindar
articles.ru: Count Horey Quindar, Second of the Five
articles.summary: A Shimmery count, member of the Council of Five, abbot of the Maximian Monastery by the Abyss, and a prominent member of the Lady in the Dark's secret order. Captured by Adrian in May 1775, he revealed the order's goal and became his adviser and intermediary with the Lady in the Dark.
searchAliases: граф Хорей Куиндар, Второй из Пяти

articles.title: Kurt Icewind
articles.ru: Baron Kurt Icewind
articles.summary: A young Agathan baron, nephew of Count Main the Hammer, and commander of the fourth, or light, company of X-cloaks during Erwin Origin's 1775 campaign. Blunt and outspoken, he repeatedly demanded a duel with Jemis Lilliday and obtained Erwin's oath concerning the Weapon. He died in the Steppe holding back Ganta Ondey's horde, and his sacrifice saved the entire army.

articles.title: Laura Farway
articles.ru: Lady Laura Farway of the Agatha family; married Laura Almer
articles.summary: Duke Henry Farway's granddaughter and Erwin Origin's former fiancée; the heroine of I Want a Pony, who became Priarch Gallard Almera's wife and a claimant to Almera. She was killed by Martin Shayland in 1775.
searchAliases: леди Лаура Фарвей рода Агаты; в замужестве Лаура Альмера

articles.title: Lady in the Dark
articles.ru: Madeline Nan-Claire, Queen of Darkwater
articles.summary: The blind Queen of Darkwater, a pure-blooded descendant of Yanmei and heir to the throne, senior among the highest masters of the secret order of Gardeners. One of the series' principal schemers behind the scenes, killed by Robert Origin.

articles.title: Leila Talmir
articles.ru: Leyla Agnes Francesca, Lady Talmir
articles.summary: The fiancée of the executed Captain Corvis. For twenty years, she lived under an assumed name as the proprietor of a roadside inn, then became chief lady-in-waiting and one of Empress Minerva's few trusted advisers.

articles.title: Liam Shellier
articles.ru: Liam Pauline Francesca of the Janmei family, Viscount Shelier
articles.summary: Minister of Progress and Transport, Adrian's collaborator in the railway reform. Weak and perpetually complaining, he was ‘sentenced’ by Minerva to remain a minister after a drunken scandal at the theatre and ultimately served her faithfully.
searchAliases: Лиам Паулина Франческа рода Янмэй, виконт Шелье

articles.title: Likein and Colistad
articles.ru: Doris Lickane and Chiron Colistad, the Foltia sea monster hunters.
articles.summary: Captains from Folta, friends of Mireille Nen-Clair, and hunters of sea monsters. In the summer of 1775, they took their two ships and the schooner Sea Arrow, with Lady Sophia Origin aboard, on a gurken hunt. Colistad sailed aboard the schooner as an adviser and saved her by recognising a keel-grabber attached to her hull.
searchAliases: Дорис Ликейн и Широн Колистад — фольтийские капитаны-охотники на морских чудовищ

articles.title: Lindsey
articles.ru: Lindsay, the maid at Waymar Castle
articles.summary: A pretty, illiterate maid of Count Shayland, assigned to the captive Minerva in Waymar in the autumn of 1774, and Sir Francis Murray's secret lover. Mira investigated her disappearance throughout November; it emerged that Martin Shayland had abducted Lindsey and that she had died in his cellar 76 hours later.

articles.title: Logan Katrina
articles.ru: Ser Logan Katrina
articles.summary: A knight of common blood, owner of a modest castle in Almera which the fugitive Joaquin passed in the autumn of 1774. In early editions of Arrow, Coin, Spark, he is a regular customer of Harmon's who earned his knighthood in Duke Aiden Almera's guard; the visit to him was removed from the 2026 edition.

articles.title: Clarence
articles.ru: Lord Clarence Madeleine Fiona of the Ludmila family, ruler of the imperial stables
articles.summary: A courtier, master of the imperial stables, and Countess Sybil Northwood's alter. He warned his lover against dangerous acquaintances and seems to have guessed at her longstanding affair with Gallard Almera. In June 1774, a Northwood baron killed him in a duel.
searchAliases: Лорд Кларенс Мадлен Фиона рода Людмилы, управитель императорских конюшен

articles.title: Sir Loren
articles.ru: Sir Lauren of Hope, knight, champion of the Aleridan tournament
articles.summary: A knight of modest means from Hope, who defeated the emperor's cousin Sir Adamar to win the knightly tournament at Aleridan in the summer of 1773. He is known only through the merchant Harmon's account.
searchAliases: сир Лорен из Надежды, рыцарь, чемпион турнира в Алеридане

articles.title: Louis Maria
articles.ru: Luis Maria of Otmel, Imperial mechanic of the second guild
articles.summary: A shy mechanic who took part in Erwin Origin's explorada beyond the River. Blackmailed by an unknown ‘captain in red’, he stabbed Erwin; later, he was found in the fort beyond the River, driven mad and believing himself to be a young goat.
searchAliases: Луис Мария из Отмели, имперский механик второй гильдии

articles.title: Louisa
articles.ru: Louise, widow of Whirlwind, merchant
articles.summary: A peasant woman from the banks of the Khanai, cook and assistant in Harmon Paula's caravan. After her husband Whirlwind's death and Harmon's flight, she took charge of the trading business herself and became Joaquin Eve Hannah's loyal friend.

articles.title: Magda Labelin
articles.ru: Magda Fiona Lilith of Sophia, Lady Labelin
articles.summary: The unattractive, coarse, and highly shrewd daughter of Duke Maurice Labelin. In Shimmery, she seized spark-eyes and a mercenary army, forced Adrian to marry her, and after the Battle for First Winter compelled him to seek peace and became Governor of the Crownlands.
searchAliases: Магда Фиона Лилит рода Софьи, леди Лабелин

articles.title: Mark
articles.ru: Mark Frida Stanley, Crown Raven
articles.summary: A commoner and cobbler's son, head of the Crown's secret guard—the ‘Raven of the Crown’—under Tellurian and Adrian, then under Erwin Origin and Minerva. A detective, a cynic, and one of the series' viewpoint characters, in the ‘Pen’ chapter.

articles.title: Martin Shayland
articles.ru: Martin Keilin Agna
articles.summary: Count Vittor Shayland's younger brother, a hunter and sadist. In pursuit of an ‘elixir of immortality’, he tortured dozens of people to death in Waymar's dungeons. He later became a Finger-bearer in the Chosen One's army, strangled Laura Farway, and died at his own brother's hand.

articles.title: Master Cyrus
articles.ru: Master Cyrus - Funeral Master and Warden of Waymar's Prison
articles.summary: Waymar Castle's undertaker and keeper of its dungeon, obsessed with ‘keeping things tidy’. He told Mira about deaths in the castle and guided her through the dungeon, told Iona about a prisoner's escape and the old count's death, and buried the fallen after the coup in Waymar.
searchAliases: Мастер Сайрус — похоронных дел мастер и смотритель темницы Уэймара

articles.title: Mother Alicia
articles.ru: Mother Alicia (Alice), the highest mother of the Chapter, head of the Agath Order
articles.summary: The grey-haired High Mother of the Foremothers' Chapter and head of the Order of Agatha. In the main series, where she is called Mother Alice, she hoped to see Erwin on the throne and worked with Cordelia and Octavia to prepare the Ecumenical Council against Gallard. In Fantasies, she certified Francis-Ilian's religious conversion and came to First Winter as the Chapter's envoy.
searchAliases: Мать Алисия (Алиса), высшая мать капитула, глава агатовского ордена

articles.title: Mother Cordelia
articles.ru: Mother of Cordelia, abbess of the Order of Ulyana Sad, bearer of the diadem
articles.summary: Abbess of the Order of Ulyana the Sorrowful and the second-ranking priestess of the Church of the Foremothers, which she effectively governed on behalf of Archmother Ellina, who had lost her mental faculties. She initiated the Ecumenical Council against Priarch Gallard and served as spiritual leader of Erwin Origin's ‘holy host’, until Paul killed her at the gates of Fliss.
searchAliases: Мать Корделия, аббатиса ордена Ульяны Печальной, носительница диадемы

articles.title: Maynir
articles.ru: Lord Mainir of the Yangmei family, Emperor Polari
articles.summary: Emperor of Polari, father of Emperor Tellurian and Manson, and Adrian's grandfather. He was remembered as a lover of life who had never enacted a single law. It was at his command that Tellurian married Ingrid, the ‘swamp woman’.
searchAliases: Владыка Мейнир рода Янмэй, император Полари

articles.title: Manson
articles.ru: Manson Louise Violetta of the Janmay family, Lord Arden
articles.summary: Emperor Tellurian's younger brother, Adrian's uncle, and a former First Admiral. After the Jesters' Conspiracy, he spent twenty years as the court jester. Under the influence of Ulyana's Dust, he stabbed Adrian with a dagger at the Beck. The viewpoint character of the ‘Cap’ chapters.
searchAliases: Менсон Луиза Виолетта рода Янмэй, лорд Арден

articles.title: Mik
articles.ru: Mick, nicknamed the Wizard
articles.summary: An orphan from Waymar with a cleft lip, to whom Nathaniel gave firstblood in 1756. After falling into the secret order's hands, he became its ‘executor’, and by 1775 he was the Sorcerer, using a stolen talking belt to rob Shayland's banks at the head of a Shavan gang, until Adrian exposed him.

articles.title: Minerva
articles.ru: Minerva Gemma Alessandra of the lineage of Yanmei, Lady Stagfort, sovereign of the Empire of Polari
articles.summary: An orphan from the northern fief of Stagfort and a distant relative of the emperor, who rose from the false identity of ‘Gloria Northwood’ and imprisonment to become Empress of Polari. A central heroine of the series and the viewpoint character of the ‘Spark’ chapters.
searchAliases: Минерва Джемма Алессандра рода Янмэй, леди Стагфорт, владычица Империи Полари

articles.title: Mireille Nen-Clair
articles.ru: Princess Mireille Nan-Claire; later Queen of Darkwater
articles.summary: The Lady in the Dark's daughter, exiled from Darkwater after a break with her mother. An initiate of the secret order who revealed the secret of the First Tree to the Origins and Minerva, and who took Darkwater's throne in 1776.
searchAliases: принцесса Мирей Нэн-Клер; позднее королева Дарквотера

articles.title: Moger Buckley
articles.ru: Moger Buckley
articles.summary: Duke Maurice Labelin's lowborn agent. He supplied the Snowdrops with spark crossbows, tracked Harmon down in Shimmery, and killed Onoriko-Maysor. Magda captured him, and Duke Labelin killed him in Erwin's dungeon.

articles.title: Moran Steppe Fire
articles.ru: Moran Steppe Fire, leader of the hordes of the West
articles.summary: A Shavan from the County of Reis and Count Damir Reis's right-hand man; after the count's murder, he became leader of the great western horde that devastated Litland. He is in love with Rebecca Litland. He was maimed by the Companions, whom he himself had sacrificed to defeat Hector, and immobilised by Paul in Rei-Roy: ‘Eternity’ cast him out of the flow of time.
searchAliases: Моран Степной Огонь, вождь орды Запада

articles.title: Maurice Labelin
articles.ru: Maurice Elvira Dorothy of Sofia, Duke of Labelin
articles.summary: The immensely corpulent, miserly, and cautious ruler of the Southern Way. He bought the counterfeit Radiant Sphere and lost half his duchy to Origin, but through his daughter's marriage to Adrian came to own more in the capital than the Dynasty itself.
searchAliases: Морис Эльвира Дороти рода Софьи, герцог Лабелин

articles.title: Mortimer
articles.ru: Mortimer, associate clerk at Shayland Bank in Crystal Falls
articles.summary: A junior clerk at Shayland's bank in Crystal Fall, through whose eyes the first part of the Companions and the Sorcerer's bank raid is shown. He survived the raid: Chara spared both him and the cashier.
searchAliases: Мортимер, младший приказчик отделения банка Шейланда в Кристал Фолле

articles.title: Navi
articles.ru: Nathaniel ("Navi"), the "god of navigation"
articles.summary: A ‘Radiant’ navigator-god from the wider galaxy, who crash-landed on Polaris in 1756. A mathematical genius who hid in an asylum for ten years, killed Paul, and, at the end of the series, revealed the truth about the Star to the people of Polari, leaving Minerva to decide whether he should live.

articles.title: Neimir
articles.ru: Neymir Werewolf (Ney)
articles.summary: A Shavan scout and former mercenary, one of the ‘Companions’ alongside Chara. He exposed Moran's betrayal and maimed him, then wandered with the Sorcerer and the Hunter, apparently betraying the latter out of jealousy. In Fantasies, he is the Steppe's envoy, making peace with Erwin Origin.

articles.title: Nexia Flame
articles.ru: Lady Nexia Flame Elena
articles.summary: A blue-eyed artist in the capital's high society, Erwin Origin's former lover and a granddaughter of the rebellious House Lightheart. She became the Puppeteer's instrument under the influence of Ulyana's Dust, then played a key role in preparing the Battle for First Winter.

articles.title: Nicholas Ollie
articles.ru: Professor Nicholas Ollie of the Sophia family
articles.summary: A professor in the physics faculty of Faunterra University and inventor of a sound-recording apparatus. In the spring of 1776, Adrian, the Labelins, the Church, and King Francis-Ilian all sought to obtain his invention at the same time. The protagonist of ‘Fantasy One: The Device’.

articles.title: Niza
articles.ru: Niz of Holliwell
articles.summary: A young Shavan woman sold into slavery in Laem. Harmon bought and freed her, and she became his companion in ballooning. Later, she left his guardianship, announced her engagement to Sir Peter, and served Magda Labelin as a lady-in-waiting and cupbearer.

articles.title: Nora
articles.ru: Nora, novice of the monastery of Ulyana Sad
articles.summary: A novice of the underground convent of Ulyana the Sorrowful and heroine of the interlude Crybaby. Having planned to kill herself, she escaped the convent thanks to her companion Mia—the future Empress Minerva.

articles.title: Aubrey
articles.ru: kair Aubrey, aide-de-camp and bodyguard to Erwin Origin, later bodyguard to Lady Iona
articles.summary: A kair of the X-cloaks, Duke Erwin Origin's adjutant and bodyguard. He infiltrated Leed Castle with Erwin and Hyder Leed and freed Iona, then became her personal bodyguard. In Fantasies, he is the ‘foremost mystic’ among the kairs and a hunter of First Winter's ghosts.
searchAliases: кайр Обри, адъютант и телохранитель Эрвина Ориджина, позднее телохранитель леди Ионы

articles.title: Odar the Haughty
articles.ru: Odar Origin, nicknamed Spesiviy, Duke of Origin
articles.summary: A Duke of Origin from long ago whose ghost, according to legend and Fantasies, is bound to the ducal chair in First Winter's great hall. For twelve years, his spirit ‘educated’ the ghost of Dallia Raven, who would later become Erwin's altessa Anxiety.
searchAliases: Одар Ориджин по прозвищу Спесивый, герцог Ориджин

articles.title: Olaf Two-Beards
articles.ru: Olaf Two-bearded, Sitting-on-a-Botch, King of Shadows and Master of the Cave
articles.summary: The leader of Labelin's underworld, ruling the beggars, thieves, and swindlers in the city's dry catacombs. In November 1774, paid with Erwin Origin's silver, his men dressed in kairs' cloaks and staged the northern army's flight, making the night massacre in Labelin possible.
searchAliases: Олаф Двубородый, Сидящий-на-Бочке, Король Теней и Хозяин Пещер

articles.title: Onoriko-Maysor
articles.ru: Onoriko-Maysor
articles.summary: A Laem matchmaker and broker of altessas, the viewpoint character of The Skyship and the Girl. He introduced Harmon to Niza and suggested the idea of a skyship, then served the merchant in Melison. He was stabbed to death by the hired killer Rodrigo on Moger Buckley's orders.

articles.title: General Oris
articles.ru: General Horis (Horis-desh, "Oris"), commander of the Sunset Coast
articles.summary: Count Rantigar's chief commander, lord of Silence in 1774–1775, and spiritual mentor of the Sunsetters. A cheerful, short glutton with a clear head, he carried Objects out of the Gift's resting place in 1756, then brought his army to Vittor Shayland in 1775 and accompanied him all the way to First Winter. His real name is Horis; the chroniclers called him ‘Oris’.

articles.title: Oswald
articles.ru: Kair Oswald
articles.summary: A stocky Origin kair who joined Erwin's explorada beyond the River, famous for undergoing initiation as a kair twice. He wavered during Jemis's rebellion but remained loyal to Erwin, and died in the night attack on the explorada's camp in the Beyond.

articles.title: Father David
articles.ru: Father David
articles.summary: An itinerant priest in a blue cloak, Harmon's old friend, Alanis's confessor, and Erwin Origin's companion. In reality, he is a brilliant agent of the secret order of Gardeners. He revealed the order's history and much about Paul and the Tree to Erwin; in October 1775, Erwin arrested him and handed him over for interrogation.

articles.title: Paul
articles.ru: Paul, Ganta pus
articles.summary: A ‘Dark’ god from the world beyond Polaris, who survived the crash alongside Nathaniel. A prisoner of Waymar for ten years, then the Puppeteer's weapon, leader of the Shavan horde, and the series' greatest military nightmare. He died outside First Winter on 2 December 1775.

articles.title: Perkins
articles.ru: Perkins, Governor of the central branch of Shayland Bank
articles.summary: An unassuming banker with spectacles, manager of the bank's central branch in Waymar and a trusted vassal of Count Vittor Shayland. In 1775, he hired mercenaries for the count, commanded them, and wore a Finger of Wilhelm. He died in a night attack on the Chosen One's camp.
searchAliases: Перкинс, управитель центрального отделения банка Шейланда

articles.title: Polly
articles.ru: Polly Janet Harvey
articles.summary: A young widow from Niar who fled the Blue-Grey Plague. She served as a cook, seamstress, and singer in Harmon's caravan and was Joaquin's lover. She tracked down her employer's kidnappers and helped recover the Radiant Sphere. She died from an accidental shot fired by Harmon, and her death haunted both men until the end of the series.

articles.title: Descendant
articles.ru: Descendant, sailor schooner "The Seal"
articles.summary: A dark-skinned sailor in the northern fleet, who served aboard the Seal on the expedition beyond the River and assured everyone that he was a direct descendant of Foremother Miriam. The narrator of He Who Speaks with God; in 1775, he sailed to Folta with Lady Sophia Origin aboard the Sea Arrow.

articles.title: Rebecca Litland
articles.ru: Rebecca Eleanor Agatha of the Sophia family, Lady Litland
articles.summary: The Duke of Litland's niece, the Empire's finest horsewoman, one of Adrian's three prospective brides, and Minerva's closest friend. In Rei-Roy, while trying to prevent Moran from allying with the heretics, she was immobilised by Paul using Eternity and is believed dead.
searchAliases: Ребекка Элеонора Агата рода Софьи, леди Литленд

articles.title: Redyar Toystone
articles.ru: Major Redyar Toystone, Commanding General of the First Black Sea Regiment
articles.summary: A former Wilhelmian monk, major, and intelligence commander of the First Blackmore Regiment, Priarch Gallard's man in Almera's army. In the summer of 1775, after Colonel Blackmore's death, he took command of the regiment's remnants, disobeyed an order to withdraw, and brought them to the Cliff near Fliss. According to Oliver Gold, this saved the priarch, but Toystone was demoted.
searchAliases: майор Редьяр Тойстоун, командир разведки первого блэкморского полка

articles.title: Richard Origin
articles.ru: Richard Sofia Jessica Agatha
articles.summary: Duke Desmond's eldest son, who vanished at sea and was presumed dead. He returned under the name Ice as a fighter in the heretics' brigade and Vittor Shayland's commander, murdered his father, and was slain by his brother Erwin.

articles.title: Robert Origin
articles.ru: Robert Emilia Gerda of Agatha
articles.summary: Erwin Origin's cousin, an imperturbable, fatalistic kair and longtime treasurer of First Winter, later imperial treasurer under Minerva. At the end of the series, he executed the Lady in the Dark to avenge his father.

articles.title: Rose Arrowback
articles.ru: Lady Rose Arrowback, daughter of Earl of Arrowback
articles.summary: Count Arrowback's daughter, a ‘pure-blooded granddaughter of Foremother Agatha’. In Fantasies, she volunteers in Faunterra's hospitals and is Somerset Lightheart's rejected bride-to-be; by the autumn of 1776, she is engaged to Robert Origin.
searchAliases: леди Роуз Эрроубэк, дочь графа Эрроубэка

articles.title: Hand Dodge
articles.ru: Sergeant Ruka Dodge (The People's Major)
articles.summary: A retired sergeant from the Southern Way who drilled Labelin's militia and the peasants following Salem of Summersweet. Together with Tooth, he seized control of the Snowdrops and fired on General Gore's envoys; after being pardoned, he became a ‘major’ of Adrian's hired thugs.

articles.title: Red
articles.ru: Red (protective agent, real name not named)
articles.summary: An agent of the Protection and Mark the Raven's assistant, the capital's foremost expert on dead bodies. He examined corpses in the cases involving the Voice of the Crown printing house and the theft of Sacred Objects, testified about Adrian's body at Manson's trial, and served the Raven until the end of the series.
searchAliases: Рыжий (агент протекции, настоящее имя не названо)

articles.title: Simon Lilliday
articles.ru: Lord Simon Lilliday, heir to the Earl of Lilliday
articles.summary: The eldest son of the Snow Count Lilliday and brother of the kair Jemis, ruler of Leed in the autumn of 1775. He refused to abandon the city before the Puppeteer's army. Desmond appointed him general of the forty thousand Leed residents recruited into the army, while Simon ordered the townspeople who remained to pretend submission to the enemy.
searchAliases: лорд Саймон Лиллидей, наследник графа Лиллидея

articles.title: Salem of Summersweet
articles.ru: Salem of Summersweet
articles.summary: A gentle peasant from the Southern Way who unwittingly became leader of the Snowdrop Rebellion. Pardoned by Minerva at the Holy Field, he later helped Harmon expose Adrian's conspiracy and joined the guild of aerial navigation. He died in the Battle for First Winter at the hands of his friend Joaquin.

articles.title: Sally
articles.ru: Sally, a student of the evening class
articles.summary: The heroine of the fantasy ‘An Essay on a Theme’, a girl from a poor Almeran town and the daughter of a maimed veteran archer. She writes a school essay about a knight and a lady, which becomes a secret correspondence with her teacher, Mrs Gale, and adds the final line: ‘The lady killed the knight’.

articles.title: Sanders
articles.ru: Sir Sanders Sally Samantha of Susan, Lord Satersveit
articles.summary: An Azure Guardsman of Adrian who survived the imperial train disaster on the Beck. He tried to save Captain Grace, pulled Adjutant Forlemay ashore, and, at the third session of Manson's trial, described the last morning aboard the train and recalled Grace's cry: ‘There's some kind of armed party over there!’.
searchAliases: Сир Сандерс Салли Саманта рода Сьюзен, лорд Сатерзвейт

articles.title: Seymour Steel
articles.ru: Seymour Steel 's
articles.summary: An Origin kair from a shepherding family, Brant Steel's brother, and captain of Iona Origin's personal guard in Waymar. Boundlessly devoted to his lady and equally merciless towards everyone else, he caused a slaughter in the One-Eyed Man's tavern and was demoted. He later died in the coup in Waymar, struck down by the fire of a Finger of Wilhelm.

articles.title: Shatterhand
articles.ru: Harvey Shatterhand
articles.summary: An officer of the Azure Guard who rescued Minerva from Waymar and became her most faithful bodyguard and adviser. Repeatedly demoted and promoted again, he remained at the empress's side until the end of the series.

articles.title: Scar
articles.ru: Kair Captain Scar, X Company Commander
articles.summary: A kair of the X-cloaks, commander of the heavy assault company in Erwin Origin's army in 1775: a bearded giant, a ‘descendant of pirates’, with an iron tooth. He fought in Almera, at Fliss, and in the Steppe, and played the card game prikup with the duke. In Fantasies, he joins Fitzgerald and Aubrey in hunting First Winter's ghost.
searchAliases: кайр капитан Шрам, командир иксовой роты

articles.title: Sybil Northwood
articles.ru: Sybil Dorina Denise of Susan, Countess of Northwood
articles.summary: Countess of Northwood, who ruled the county on behalf of her elderly husband. She devised the substitution of brides, passing her daughter Gloria off as Minerva Stagfort. After being exposed, she lost her memory in the Faraday-Riley asylum, became the viewpoint character of ‘Witness’ under the name Dorothy Sly, and was hanged on Adrian's orders.
searchAliases: Сибил Дорина Дениза рода Сьюзен, графиня Нортвуд

articles.title: Snipe
articles.ru: Snipe
articles.summary: A sullen guard of the merchant Harmon, a deserter from Blackmore who hated lords. He helped free his employer and recover the Radiant Sphere, then stole it so he could return to his wife and children, taking Polly hostage. Harmon shot him; the same bolt also killed Polly.

articles.title: Sophie
articles.ru: Sophie, servant of Lady Alanis Almera; in Fantasies, the mute Sophie
articles.summary: A maid who fled burning Evergard with the wounded Alanis and nursed her along the way. She remained at Blackmore Castle when Joaquin took her mistress away. In Fantasies, the mute girl Sophie in Sir Humphrey's band appears to kill Adrian during the storming of the Chamber and dies from Golden Mane's Finger.
searchAliases: Софи, служанка леди Аланис Альмера; в «Фантазиях» — немая Софи

articles.title: Sophia Jessica Augusta
articles.ru: Sophia Jessica Augusta of Agatha, Duchess of Origin
articles.summary: Duke Desmond's wife and the mother of Richard, Erwin, and Iona, a native of Aleridan and a passionate theatre lover. In Humans and Gods and The Shadow of the Great Tree, she narrates the ‘Mask’ chapters about a months-long embassy by sea to Mireille Nen-Clair and a voyage beyond the edge of the known world. She returned the day after her husband's death.
searchAliases: София Джессика Августа рода Агаты, герцогиня Ориджин

articles.title: Somerset Flame
articles.ru: Viscount Somerset Patricia Cleon of Helena, Somerset Flame
articles.summary: Count Edgar Flame's son and Nexia's brother, a student in the capital and a viscount of the Lightheart lineage. He carried his sister's letter to Erwin across the front line, accompanied Nexia to Waymar, and in Fantasies became entangled between his wealthy fiancée Rose Arrowback and Professor Ollie's assistant.
searchAliases: виконт Сомерсет Патриция Клеона рода Елены, Сомерсет Флейм

articles.title: Sormakh
articles.ru: Sormakh, Shavan, the strongest of the horsemen of Ganta Thunderstorm
articles.summary: An enormous Shavan, a rider in Ganta Thunderstorm's band, seeking revenge on the northerners for his father and brothers. In Marengo, he challenged Erwin Origin to a duel and lost a hand; later, already one-handed, he became one of Paul's khanids in the campaign against the North.
searchAliases: Сормах, шаван, сильнейший из всадников ганты Грозы

articles.title: Forty-Two
articles.ru: Henry Horton, nicknamed Forty-Two
articles.summary: A young Origin kair, General Horton's son, champion of the tournament at Doyle, and one of the first X-cloaks. Under Lord Chancellor Erwin, he supervised the Protection. Severely maimed in the Dynasty's tomb, he was healed by Nathaniel and founded the ‘Ministry of Aerial Navigation’ with Harmon Paula; in Fantasies, he is assistant to Harmon, the Minister of Aerial Navigation.
searchAliases: кайр Генри Хортон, прозванный Сорок Два

articles.title: Statham
articles.ru: Colonel-General Garrett Amanda Gina of the Agatha family, Baron Statham
articles.summary: A prime vassal of House Origin, Baron of the Sheep Valleys, and colonel-general, a stern ‘northern wolf’ of the old school. During Erwin's rebellion, he captured Doyle, assumed command at Pixie, and, following the instructions in a sealed packet left for him, destroyed the spark-equipped army in Labelin's night battle. He then served as Minerva and Erwin's envoy to Priarch Gallard, and in the war against the Puppeteer fought under Desmond through to the Battle for First Winter.
searchAliases: генерал-полковник Гаррет Аманда Джина рода Агаты, барон Стэтхем

articles.title: Theobart
articles.ru: Kair Theobarth, captain of the Kairs
articles.summary: Captain of the kairs in Erwin Origin's expedition beyond the River and a former squire of Duke Desmond. Mortally wounded in the night attack on the camp beside the Gift's resting place, he was the first to identify the attackers as the Crown's men and took his own life.

articles.title: Ufretin
articles.ru: Captain Ufretin, commander of the St. Straus Brigade
aliases: the Commander of the Holy Straus
articles.summary: Captain of the Holy Ostrich mercenary brigade in Shimmery, a mushroom-eater and avid gambler, owner of the fighting ostrich Fury. He served the Fourth of the Five in Izerin, went over to Magda Labelin when the city was taken, and later joined Adrian with his brigade.
searchAliases: капитан Уфретин, командир бригады Святого Страуса

articles.title: William Davy
articles.ru: General Sir William Davey
articles.summary: An imperial general from the Sunset Coast, a rough-mannered firstborn knight, one of the Empire's finest strategists, and Erwin Origin's friend and Stratems partner. He devised Adrian's winning plan at Melorange, held the besieged city with his spark-equipped regiment, and, after being transferred north, fought in the Battle for First Winter. In Fantasies, he is called a war hero and a legend.

articles.title: Whitmore
articles.ru: Captain Sir Derek Whitmore
articles.summary: A captain of the Azure Guard of Yanmei's lineage, whose company took the Dynasty's Objects out of the capital in December 1774 and lost them on the road to Marengo. To redeem his disgrace, he tracked down witnesses to the theft with Major Beckfield. He then served Minerva: setting an ambush in Ingrid's tomb, bringing in Inzhi Price, and commanding the second Azure company until the end of the series.

articles.title: Walter Jane John
articles.ru: Walter Jane John, Master of the Executory Guild
articles.summary: An executioner, master of the Guild of Executioners, and friend and partner of the lawman Macfreed Crow—by all indications, Mark the Raven under a new name. He met him on the Day of the Descent in 1775; in Fantasies, they investigate the ‘dog case’ in Finborough in 1776 and a priest's death in Winslow in 1777. He takes pride in never having executed anyone whose guilt he doubted.
searchAliases: Уолтер Джейн Джон, мастер гильдии экзекуторов

articles.title: Valerie Graysend
articles.ru: Valerie of the genus Sophia Velichava, Marquis of Gracend
articles.summary: A young marchioness from the Southern Way, one of Emperor Adrian's three prospective brides, later General Alexis Smile's wife and a lady-in-waiting to Magda Labelin.
searchAliases: Валери рода Софьи Величавой, маркиза Грейсенд

articles.title: Walter Origin
articles.ru: Walter Origin, “The Silent Jack”
articles.summary: A northern lord, father of Robert and Damon Origin, who disappeared during the campaign in Windley in the autumn of 1765. Harmon found his skeleton in a coat bearing the Origin bat in the monks' dungeon outside Labelin and called him Silent Jack. From that coat, Robert learned that the Lady in the Dark's people had tortured his father to death.

articles.title: Vanden
articles.ru: Sir Vanden, Knight Countess of Northwood
articles.summary: A Northwood knight and swordsman, one of two warriors who accompanied Countess Sybil Northwood to the capital in 1774. He guarded Mira while she lived with the countess under Gloria's name and seems to have sympathised with her; the countess later sent him away somewhere.

articles.title: Vanessa-Lilith
articles.ru: Vanessa-Lilith
articles.summary: A white-blooded noblewoman of Lyudmila's lineage from Laem, wife of the matchmaker Onoriko-Maysor. She threw her husband out of the house over his debts. In the spring of 1775, Moger Buckley's men stabbed Rico to death before her eyes, then locked her, her children, and Harmon in a cellar without water; Niza rescued them. In Fantasies, the widow continues her husband's business and becomes Laem's most successful matchmaker.

articles.title: Wexler
articles.ru: General Sir Wexler
articles.summary: An Almeran general, commander of the First Aleridan Regiment, the finest in the Dukes of Almera's army.
