In the summer of 1775, he fought for Priarch Gallard against Erwin Origin: near Beck Castle, his knights routed Arrowback's battalion but were themselves defeated by a kair attack from the rear. During the night battle in Beaver Wood, the Leed Wolves in white cloaks shot him dead with crossbows.

articles.title: Werner
articles.ru: Kair Werner
articles.summary: An Origin kair, sentry at the palace's goods gate in Faunterra. With Ragolf and Tenn, he received the Healer; during her escape, he stabbed her to death and was immediately killed by a Northwood man's axe.

articles.title: Jolly
articles.ru: Maximian, son of Isidore and Leopold, nicknamed Veselchak
articles.summary: A peasant from the village of Zhuravliki in the Southern Way, a Labelin militiaman who became Joaquin Eve Hannah's squire and friend. Forever predicting ‘little coffins and shovels’, he nevertheless saved Joaquin's life near Hampton, sought patrons to protect him in the capital, exposed Adrian's conspiracy with Salem and Harmon, and served in the guild of aerial navigation in First Winter.
searchAliases: Максимиан, сын Исидоры и Леопольда, по прозвищу Весельчак

articles.title: Whirlwind
articles.ru: Vortex, stableman and merchant loader Harmon
articles.summary: A shaggy, dark-haired peasant, groom and porter in the merchant Harmon's caravan, Louisa's husband and father of Sarah and Little Whirlwind. On 4 July 1774, during the retreat from Brother Ludwig's monks, he saved his employer but lost his fingers and soon died of blood poisoning.
searchAliases: Вихорь, конюх и грузчик купца Хармона

articles.title: Vincent Shayland
articles.ru: Count Vincent Shayland
articles.summary: Count of Shayland, father of Vittor and Martin, grandson of a fugitive merchant, and husband of the daughter of the previous dynasty's last count. In 1756, he received the Seventeenth Gift in Waymar; years later, he died of fright in his locked study, and his death became part of the mystery of Waymar's prisoner.

articles.title: Vittor Shayland
articles.ru: Vittor Kaylin Agna of the Vivian family, Earl of Shayland
articles.summary: A banker-count from Waymar, Iona Origin's husband. Behind the mask of a courteous financier lurked the Puppeteer, master of Wilhelm's Fingers. After his ‘resurrection’, he proclaimed himself the Chosen One of the gods, led an army against First Winter, killed his own brother, and was frozen inside the Womb.
searchAliases: Виттор Кейлин Агна рода Вивиан, граф Шейланд

articles.title: Grandson
articles.ru: Grandson, student and bodyguard of Grandfather (no real name)
articles.summary: A young northerner, Grandfather's pupil and bodyguard. He accompanied Grandfather and Mark the Raven in the investigation of the stolen Dynasty's Objects, was wounded in an attack on a train, and, in the summer of 1775, sailed with Lady Sophia Origin on the expedition to Folta under the nickname Cabin Boy.
searchAliases: Внучок, ученик и телохранитель Деда (настоящее имя не названо)

articles.title: Johan Reis
articles.ru: Johan Reis, Jr. Count Reis
articles.summary: The son of the murdered Count Damir Reis, lord of Rei-Roy and its innumerable herds. He was the first to recognise Paul as ‘Pus-Ganta’, became his ‘right hand’, and led the southern half of the horde towards Faunterra. Defeated and captured at Patrick's Chapel, he was a bearer of firstblood whom Adrian used to operate Objects. He was poisoned.

articles.title: Juliana the Great
articles.ru: Juliana Oranta Adelia of the Janmei family, Lady Polari
articles.summary: The legendary sixteenth-century Empress of Polari. She ruled for half a century, ended the Horse Wars, established the Empire's borders, and introduced a single code of laws for all its lands. Her image serves as a standard against which the series' rulers are measured.
searchAliases: Юлиана Оранта Аделия рода Янмэй, владычица Полари

articles.title: Golden Mane
articles.ru: Golden Griva (formerly Yellow Griva), Shavan in the service of Adrian
articles.summary: A one-handed Shavan from Fantasies, formerly Adrian's prisoner, who became his ‘first blade’. Through the Sacred Object called the ‘Bird’, he watches Faunterra and distant lands for the sovereign. He died outside the Chamber building in November 1776. By all indications, he is the same one-handed Shavan captive whom Adrian kept asleep on the moon-eye in The Shadow of the Great Tree.
searchAliases: Златая Грива (прежде Жёлтая Грива), шаван на службе Адриана

articles.title: The Healer
articles.ru: The Messenger of the Covenant
articles.summary: The Puppeteer's emissary, carrying a healing Object—the Healer's Hand. In the spring of 1775, she came to the palace in Faunterra to treat the petrified Lord Desmond in exchange for the Voice of God, healed Iona, promised to restore Alanis's beauty, and died by the sword of the kair Werner in the Northwoods' camp. Her Object passed to the Origins, and Minerva and Leila later experimented with blood taken from her corpse.

articles.title: Tooth
articles.ru: Tooth, a dentist from Lawville ("people's general")
articles.summary: A dentist from Lowville, leader of the townspeople in the Snowdrops' army. He proposed the slogan of a ‘fair tax’, joined Hand Dodge in firing on General Gore's envoys and removing Salem from power, and, after the pardon, led the former Snowdrops into Adrian's service.
searchAliases: Зуб, зубной лекарь из Лоувилля («народный генерал»)

articles.title: The Absolute
articles.ru: The Absolute is a component Sacred Object
articles.summary: A composite device made from seventeen Sacred Objects, for which the Puppeteer turned the Empire upside down. Believed to grant immortality, it is, according to Navi, a ‘means of transport’ that allows instant travel to any visible point.

articles.title: Wine and Spirits
articles.ru: Alcoholic beverages Polari: orge, hanty, kerchief, wine, beer and the wonders of the outskirts
articles.summary: Polari's principal spirits are the North's conifer-flavoured ordzh, the finest of which is made in Leed, and the spiced Northwood infusion khanti. Ordinary people drink cheap, cloudy kosukha; the South is famed for wine and Shayland for beer. Comparisons with real-world drinks in the article are the wiki's interpretation.
searchAliases: Алкогольные напитки Полари: ордж, ханти, косуха, вина, пиво и диковинки окраин

articles.title: Alter and Altessa
articles.ru: Alter and althessa - recognized lovers in the customs of the nobility of Polari
articles.summary: An alter is the acknowledged lover of a married noblewoman; an altessa is a nobleman's beloved. Scripture permits such relationships with reference to Foremother Sophia, and they are customary at the capital's and southern courts. Erwin Origin also calls Anxiety, his imaginary conversational companion, his altessa.
searchAliases: Альтер и альтесса — признанные любовники в обычаях знати Полари

articles.title: The Author (in the World of Polari)
articles.ru: The author of Arrow, Coin, Spark as a character in the world of Polari - as seen by Lady Karen
aliases: Author of the novel in the world of Polari
Author Arrow Coin Sparks in the World
articles.summary: In the remarks accompanying the Collector's Edition, the novel Arrow, Coin, Spark exists within Polari itself, and its unnamed author becomes a character: Lady Karen catches his mistakes, wonders who he is and how he knows everything, and asks the protagonists what they think of the book.
searchAliases: Автор «Стрелы, монеты, искры» как персонаж мира Полари — каким его видит леди Карен
автор Стрелы монеты искры в мире

articles.title: The Womb
articles.ru: The Womb is a sacred object in the form of a crystal coffin.
articles.summary: The largest and heaviest of the Sacred Objects, found in the resting place of the Seventeenth Gift: a transparent coffin that puts a person into a kind of frozen sleep. According to Navi, it is a starship escape capsule; in 1775, Adrian imprisoned the immortal Puppeteer inside the Womb together with the Absolute.
searchAliases: Чрево — Священный Предмет в виде хрустального гроба

articles.title: Gifts of the Gods
articles.ru: Gifts of the Gods - the arrival of Sacred Objects in the world of Polari
articles.summary: Rare events in which a resting place containing Sacred Objects opens in the earth. In Polari, they are considered gifts from the gods; extracting these treasures requires dangerous work and sometimes causes wars.
searchAliases: Дары богов — приход Священных Предметов в мир Полари

articles.title: Money
articles.ru: The monetary system of the Empire of Polari: coins, exchange rates, money changing, banks, and banknotes
articles.summary: Polari's monetary system is based on the agatka: a gloria equals 8 agatkas, an elena equals 8 glorias (64 agatkas), and a hilt equals 4 elenas (256 agatkas). Small change consists of the half-agatka poltinka and the copper little star. In 1775, with bankers' assistance, Empress Minerva introduced paper banknotes bearing her name into widespread circulation.
searchAliases: Денежная система Империи Полари: монеты, курс, обмен, банки и ассигнации

articles.title: Voice of Winter (Sword)
articles.ru: The Voice of Winter - the ancestral sword of the Dukes of Origin
articles.summary: Voice of Winter is the legendary ancestral sword of the Dukes of Origin, forged two hundred and twenty years before the events of the series and known as ‘the fastest sword in the world’. In 1775, Desmond Origin gave it to his son Erwin, who fought with it until the end of the war and used it to kill his brother Richard.
searchAliases: Глас Зимы — родовой меч герцогов Ориджин

articles.title: Glossary
articles.ru: Polari World Glossary - Titles, Ranks, Money, Faith, Techniques and Local Words
articles.summary: A concise dictionary of words and concepts from the Polari series: forms of address and titles, ranks and offices, coins and measures, ecclesiastical terms, Sacred Objects, spark technology, Shavan and Sunset Coast words, local nicknames, curses, festivals, and the reckoning of time.
searchAliases: Глоссарий мира Полари — титулы, чины, деньги, вера, техника и местные слова

articles.title: Voice of God
articles.ru: The Voice of God —The Subject of Distant Communication
articles.summary: A bracelet-Object for instantaneous voice communication over any distance. Paul used it to issue commands to the deconstructor, destroying Objects he touched. At the end of the series, the Voice of God, together with the deconstructor's keys, came into Adrian's possession.

articles.title: Voice of the Crown
articles.ru: The Voice of the Crown
articles.summary: Polari's only printed news publication, produced by the printing house at Faunterra's Imperial University; it serves as the government's mouthpiece.

articles.title: Spark
articles.ru: Spark - electricity and spark technology Polari
articles.summary: In Polari, electricity is called spark. Spark-powered dams and workshops supply lamps, pumps, samovars, trains, urban tramcars, and the ‘wave’—a wired telegraph—while weapons equipped with spark ‘eyes’ have made the imperial infantry a formidable force. The Crown's monopoly on spark is one of the pillars of its power.
searchAliases: Искра — электричество и искровая техника Полари

articles.title: Calendar
articles.ru: Chronicle and Calendar of the Polari Empire
articles.summary: In Polari, years are counted ‘from the Descent of the Foremothers’; the main series takes place in 1774–1775. The year's major festivals are Spring Dawn, Sophia's Days, Abundance, the Day of the Descent on 2 December, and the emperor's birthday. Times of day are marked by the Church's ‘songs’.

articles.title: Stone Sickness
articles.ru: Stone disease - a disease that turns the skin into stone
articles.summary: Stone Sickness is a terrible disease that slowly turns a person's skin to stone and leaves them unable to move. Duke Desmond Origin contracted it in 1774; Erwin later concluded that his father's illness had been a poisoning passed off as a curse from the gods.
searchAliases: Каменная хворь — болезнь, превращающая кожу в камень

articles.title: Drop of the Sun
articles.ru: A Drop of the Sun - Ingrid's pendant, the last part of the Absolute
articles.summary: A Sacred Object of the Dynasty from the Seventeenth Gift: a pendant shaped like a ring containing amber, within which a spiral of points forming a ‘universe’ glows. Empress Ingrid wore it for ten years and was buried with it. In May 1775, the Puppeteer's brigade stole it from the Farewell Tomb, and it became the missing component of the Absolute.
searchAliases: Капля Солнца — кулон владычицы Ингрид, последняя часть Абсолюта

articles.title: Timeline of the Series
articles.ru: Chronology of the cycle "Polars": from the Descent of the Foremothers to "Fantasies"
articles.summary: A consolidated, dated chronicle of Polari's world: key historical events mentioned in the books and the Guide to the Lands of Polari; a month-by-month timeline of the six novels and their interludes, from March 1774 to December 1775 after the Descent; and the Fantasies stories set in 1776–1777.
searchAliases: Хронология цикла «Полари»: от Сошествия Праматерей до «Фантазий»

articles.title: Box from the Beyond
articles.ru: A round metal box in the hands of a dried-up dead man behind the River
articles.summary: A mysterious small round metal box found beyond the River by Erwin Origin's expedition in June 1774, in the hands of a dead man beneath an ash tree whose body had withered to a skeleton. Around the corpse, grass and bark had turned to grey dust. The box's contents were never discovered; by all indications, the dead man was a victim of Paul's experiments as he sought the deconstructor's frequency by injecting prisoners with the Dew of Happiness.
searchAliases: Круглая металлическая коробочка в руках иссохшего мертвеца за Рекой

articles.title: Adrian's Pendant
articles.ru: The pendant (medallion) of Lord Adrian is a small Sacred Object.
aliases: pendant with the image of the goddess
articles.summary: A Minor Sacred Object that Emperor Adrian wore around his neck: a small glass rod containing a lifelike three-dimensional figure of a beautiful woman. Adrian never explained who she was; in the series' final chapter, Navi looked into the pendant, wept, and spoke of the dead Lilanna.
searchAliases: Кулон (медальон) владыки Адриана — малый Священный Предмет

articles.title: Azure Guard
articles.ru: The Crown Guard
articles.summary: The imperial house's elite guard, wearing blue armour and protecting the sovereign and the Dynasty's Objects; under Minerva, her personal and most loyal guard.

articles.title: The Legend of Gett
articles.ru: The legend of Getta, Hanosha and calf Ollae - steppe parable
aliases: The Legend of the Magic Calf
The Legend of the Magic Calf
articles.summary: A Shavan legend about the brothers Gett and Khanosh and the miraculous calf Ollai, who shared his magical power with them. Greedy Gett took all the calf's power, became a bull-headed monster, and died beneath the walls of Fairis, while kind Khanosh saved Ollai. Niza tells the story to Harmon, and it becomes a recurring metaphor: Harmon is compared to both Ollai and Gett, while Erwin sees a new Gett in Moran.
searchAliases: Легенда о Гетте, Ханоше и телёнке Оллае — степная притча

articles.title: Liola and Karrog
articles.ru: "Liola and Carrog" - Miriam's legend and mystery about the goddess of meadows, the god of the volcano and the warrior Reomur
aliases: The Legend of Liol and Carrog
The Legend of Liol and Carrog
articles.summary: A classical mystery play of the Miriam tradition about Liola, goddess of the meadows, Karrog, god of the volcano, and the warrior Réaumur, who put the god to sleep with a flower petal. Minerva attends a ‘fresh interpretation’ at the Grand Crown Theatre; during the performance she quarrels with Iona, and in the interval the drunken Minister Shellier publicly humiliates the empress.
searchAliases: «Лиола и Каррог» — мириамская легенда и мистерия о богине лугов, боге вулкана и воине Реомюре

articles.title: Peoples and Lineages of Polari
articles.ru: Nations, Lands, and Kinds - The Foremothers in Polari - and Their Real Parallels
articles.summary: How people are distinguished in Polari: by their Foremother's lineage, inherited through the mother and possessed only by nobles, and by their homeland, with its characteristic appearance and customs. The word ‘race’ does not appear in the books. The article gathers what the texts say about the appearance and character of lineages and peoples, and which real-world peoples they resemble, according to the author's statements and observations.
searchAliases: Народы, земли и родá Праматерей в Полари — и их реальные параллели

articles.title: Inconsistencies and Errors
articles.ru: Inconsistencies and errors of the Polari cycle - contradictions between books, errors of publications and author's corrections
articles.summary: A survey of known discrepancies in the Polari series: how early editions of Arrow, Coin, Spark differ from the canonical 2026 edition, which typographical errors and inconsistencies remain in the text, and where the novels, interludes, and Fantasies contradict one another.
searchAliases: Нестыковки и ошибки цикла «Полари» — противоречия между книгами, ошибки изданий и авторские исправления

articles.title: Horde of Wanderers
articles.ru: Horde of Wanderers and Wandering Spirits in the Shavan Faith
articles.summary: In the beliefs of the western Shavans, the Horde of Wanderers is an incorporeal host of souls who lived worthy riders' lives. When the Spirit of the Worm devours the world, the Horde will leave to roam another universe. Only those who die ‘properly’ may join it: on their feet, with their debts paid, and without betraying their own people.
searchAliases: Орда Странников и Духи-Странники в вере шаванов

articles.title: The Weapon
articles.ru: The weapon is Erwin Origin's live chisel.
articles.summary: The Weapon is a captured Shavan with a Finger of Wilhelm whom Erwin Origin turned into a living weapon in July 1775: the prisoner was screwed to a chair, and his will was broken with screws driven into his skull. Jemis Lilliday became the Weapon's operator. It decided the Battle of the Roydan and the fighting on the Belomorye road outside First Winter.

articles.title: Allusions
articles.ru: References in the Polari cycle — hints at books, films, science and winged phrases of the real world
aliases: Unity and the Struggle of Opposites
articles.summary: Polari's Easter eggs are winks to the reader. Magda guesses the ‘death paper’ from Death Note, Erwin promises ‘happiness for everyone’ as in the Strugatskys, Gitan cries ‘My carriage!’ like Chatsky, and Prince Hector says ‘one does not simply…’. The article distinguishes references confirmed by the author from coincidences that cannot yet confidently be called Easter eggs.
searchAliases: Отсылки в цикле «Полари» — намёки на книги, фильмы, науку и крылатые фразы реального мира

articles.title: Chamber of Representatives
articles.ru: House of Representatives (Legislative Chamber)
articles.summary: The oldest governing body of the Empire of Polari: an assembly of representatives of the lands, without whose consent the sovereign's laws do not apply beyond the Crownlands. Adrian dissolved the Chamber in the autumn of 1774; under her agreement with Origin, Minerva reconvened it in May 1775.

articles.title: Glove of Might
articles.ru: Yangmei Mercy Gauntlet of Power — The Sacred Subject of Weight Management
articles.summary: Foremother Yanmei's most ancient Sacred Object: a mirror-like film of flowing metal that fits over the hand, removes objects' weight, and moves them with ‘rays’ from the fingers. Minerva put it on in the winter of 1774 and learned to control it with Navi's help; at the end of the series, Nathaniel's fate depends on the Glove.
searchAliases: Перчатка Могущества Янмэй Милосердной — Священный Предмет управления весом

articles.title: Wilhelm's Fingers
articles.ru: Wilhelm's Fingers - Combat Sacred Objects
articles.summary: Combat Sacred Objects shaped like stone bands worn around the forearm, projecting flame and an invisible ‘whip’. According to legend, Forefather Wilhelm used them to subdue the nomads and then drowned the Objects. Rediscovered in the Beyond, they became the principal weapons of the Puppeteer and Paul; after the war, the Church demanded repentance from all Finger-bearers.

articles.title: Firstblood
articles.ru: Blood is a property of blood that allows you to control Sacred Objects
articles.summary: A special property of blood without which Sacred Objects will not ‘speak’ to a person; it is transmitted through a bearer's bodily fluids. On Polaris, its sources were the outsiders Nathaniel and Paul.
searchAliases: Первокровь — свойство крови, позволяющее управлять Священными Предметами

articles.title: Firstborn
articles.ru: Primordials - the highest nobility of Polari, descendants of the Foremothers
articles.summary: In Polari, the hereditary nobles descended from the holy Foremothers are called firstborn. Lineage is inherited through the mother and stated in a person's full name. Noble standing depends on the Foremother's order in scripture and the number of Sacred Objects in the family's possession. The end of the series reveals that the firstborn are descendants of a starship's crew.
searchAliases: Первородные — высшее дворянство Полари, потомки Праматерей

articles.title: The World of Polari
articles.ru: The Polari Empire and the Polaris mainland - the world of the cycle of Roman Surzhikov
articles.summary: Polari is an empire on the continent of Polaris. It is ruled by the Illustrious Dynasty of Yanmei's lineage, while its lands belong to thirteen Great Houses descended from the holy Foremothers. It is a world of knights, monasteries, and Sacred Objects, into which spark, railways, and the ‘wave’ burst in the eighteenth century after the Descent. At the end of the series, the Foremothers themselves are revealed to have been survivors of a starship crash.
searchAliases: Империя Полари и материк Поларис — мир цикла Романа Суржикова

articles.title: Sorcerer's Belt
articles.ru: The Sorcerer's Belt - A Protective Sacred Object
articles.summary: A Sacred Object shaped like a belt with multicoloured plaques, giving its wearer an invisible shield and ‘sparks’. Mik used it to pose as the Sorcerer until Adrian exposed him in 1775; later, Richard Origin wore an identical belt in the Battle for First Winter.

articles.title: Agatha the Radiant
articles.ru: Holy Mother Agatha the Radiant
articles.summary: Agatha the Radiant is the fourth Foremother in the order of scripture, a wise seer and strategist, and author of Moments, Fantasies, and Illusions. The Origins and Almeras are her descendants. The North considers her the greatest of the Foremothers. Her famous ‘Decision of Agatha’ in the year 36 after the Descent laid the foundation of a united empire. According to Navi, she was an astrophysicist aboard the lost starship.

articles.title: Elena the Traveller
articles.ru: Holy Mother Elena the Traveler (Elena the Seer)
articles.summary: Elena the Traveller, also called the Far-Sighted, is the fifth Foremother in the scriptural canon, patroness of wanderers, seafarers, cartographers, and merchants. She could see through any obstruction using the Bird without Flesh and drew detailed maps of Polaris. According to Navi, she was the starship's first navigator. The Lighthearts, including Karen, and most Farways descend from her.

articles.title: Emilia
articles.ru: Holy Mother Emilia
articles.summary: Emilia is the Foremother of the love of souls, the ‘mother of pure love’, and creator of the alphabet. Emilian love is a kinship of souls that knows no barriers; Iona considered it the highest of the three kinds. Emilia wrote about attaining eternal love. She is invoked in wedding wishes: ‘If there is a quarrel, Emilia will reconcile you’.

articles.title: Gloria the Protectress
articles.ru: Holy Mother Gloria the Intercessor
articles.summary: Gloria the Protectress is the sixth Foremother in the scriptural canon, the ‘kindest of the Foremothers’ and patroness of ordinary people, who hears every prayer. She is especially revered in the North alongside Agatha. Her profile appears on the silver gloria coin. The Flemings and Lillidays descend from her.

articles.title: Lyudmila
articles.ru: Holy Mother Lyudmila
articles.summary: Lyudmila is the Foremother of farmers, patroness of agriculture and the weather. Peasants pray to her; according to legend, she could control the weather. Her lineage is renowned for loyalty: Baron Esher, Vanessa-Lilith, and the kair Dagober descend from her.

articles.title: Miriam the Dark-Eyed
articles.ru: Holy Mother Miriam Dark-eyed
articles.summary: Miriam the Dark-Eyed is the first Foremother in the scriptural canon, patroness of love and pleasure. According to legend, she could fly. The kings of the three Dark-Eyed Dynasties, which ended during the Crimson Turmoil, traced their descent from her. Her precept is ‘Miriam's right’: a girl's first night belongs to her alone.

articles.title: Sophia the Majestic
articles.ru: Holy Mother Sophia the Great
articles.summary: Sophia the Majestic is the third Foremother in the scriptural canon, the ‘mother of all children’, patroness of the hearth, care, and maternal love. Her symbol is an ear of grain. She is the patroness of the Southern Way; the Labelins, Valerie Graysend, and Francis-Ilian belong to her lineage. Sophia's Days, a season of weddings, are celebrated in her honour.

articles.title: Susan
articles.ru: The Holy Mother Susan
articles.summary: Susan is the seventh Foremother in the scriptural canon, the ‘Foremother of health’. Her number is seven and her symbol a flower: she possessed the Flower of Life, each petal of which could cure any illness. She is credited with power over rain and forests. The Counts of Northwood descend from her.

articles.title: Ulyana the Sorrowful
articles.ru: Holy Mother of Ulyana Sad
articles.summary: Ulyana the Sorrowful is the seventeenth and last Foremother in the scriptural canon, who left no descendants. The ‘little sister of death’, mistress of cold light, and comforter of the suffering. She was fatally wounded by a tusker's horn, and Yanmei ended her suffering with a stiletto thrust. Her nuns live in cave convents under a vow of silence. Ulyana's Dust is named in her honour.

articles.title: Vivian
articles.ru: Holy Mother Vivian
articles.summary: Vivian is the Foremother of celebration and joy, patroness of gamblers. Her temples are designed to bring joy: a fountain flows in place of an altar. House Shayland descends from her, and she is honoured above all other Foremothers in Shayland. She is credited with the words: ‘Those who take no joy in life do not deserve long years’.

articles.title: Yanmei the Merciful
articles.ru: Holy Mother Yangmei the Merciful
articles.summary: Yanmei the Merciful is the second Foremother in the order of scripture, adviser to Wilhelm the Great, a builder, and author of the Diaries from which people learn to rule. The Illustrious Dynasty descends from her. She earned the epithet ‘Merciful’ by ending the suffering of the mortally wounded Ulyana. At the end of the series, she is revealed to have been the lost starship's chief engineer.

articles.title: Yumin
articles.ru: Holy Mother Yumin
articles.summary: Yumin is the Foremother of justice, author of Justice and Action and of memoirs. Her ‘first axiom’ requires all doubts to be interpreted in the accused's favour, and her precepts exempt the insane from responsibility. According to legend, she tried Yanmei's pupil Gavin and discovered that Ulyana's Dust enslaves human will.

articles.title: Foremothers
articles.ru: Holy Mothers and Forefathers - Forebears of Humanity
articles.summary: The holy Foremothers and Forefathers are the Forebears who came into the world at the Descent and founded the Empire of Polari. Every noble family traces its lineage to the Foremothers. At the end of the series, Navi reveals that the Forebears were the surviving crew of a lost starship.
searchAliases: Святые Праматери и Праотцы — Прародители человечества Полари

articles.title: Grandfather's Parables
articles.ru: Proverbs of Deda - stories with which the northern judge answers questions
articles.summary: The parables, tales, and riddles that the retired northern judge called Grandfather tells Mark, Erwin, Lady Sophia, and others instead of giving a direct answer: from the chest of faith and the devil Hen to the craftsman from Toystone, mice used to test a cat, and the locked room. The listener usually works out the meaning, and the parable often proves the key to a mystery in the plot.
searchAliases: Притчи Деда — истории, которыми северный судья отвечает на вопросы

articles.title: Bird without Flesh
articles.ru: Bird without Flesh — The Sacred Subject of Elena the Traveler
articles.summary: An original Object of Foremother Elena the Traveller, shaped like a golden petrel with a glowing beak. Its little light can fly any distance and open a ‘viewing window’ through which everything it sees is visible. Kept in Shimmery, it was given to Adrian by Francis-Ilian in 1775; Adrian used the Bird to watch the Battle for First Winter and to show the Star.
searchAliases: Птаха без Плоти — Священный Предмет Елены-Путешественницы

articles.title: Adrian's Reforms
articles.ru: The Reforms of Emperor Adrian: Rail Construction and the General Land Tax
articles.summary: Emperor Adrian's plan to connect all the Empire's major cities by rail and finance construction through a general tax on the Great Houses in place of their military service. The Chamber's 1774 vote on it set the series' events in motion. The reform failed, but Minerva later implemented its taxation component in the Crownlands.
searchAliases: Реформы императора Адриана: рельсовое строительство и всеобщий налог с земель

articles.title: Roman Surzhikov
articles.ru: Roman Surzhikov - author of the series "Polars" and the novel "Traces on the Water"
articles.summary: Author of the fantasy series Polari and the novel Traces on the Water, set in the world of wells. The article collects what he has said about himself, his books, and his writing process during livestreams with readers.
searchAliases: Роман Суржиков — автор цикла «Полари» и романа «Следы на воде»

articles.title: Healer's Hand
articles.ru: The Hand of the Healer (Hand of the Healer) — a Healing Sacred Object
articles.summary: A healing Object made of thimbles connected by a luminous web of threads. In skilled hands it knits tissue and bone; in unskilled hands it cuts and breaks swords. The Puppeteer's agent known as the Healer brought it to First Winter. Later, Navi and Iona used the Object to heal, and in December 1775 Adrian tried to make it explode.
searchAliases: Рука Знахарки (Длань Целителя) — целительный Священный Предмет

articles.title: Blue-Grey Plague
articles.ru: Sisy Mor (Sisy Death)
articles.summary: A deadly infectious disease that turns the lips, fingers, and face blue; an outbreak of the Blue-Grey Plague devastated the city of Niar in the spring of 1774.

articles.title: The Author's Word
articles.ru: The word of the author - what Roman Surzhikov told about the cycle "Polars" on the streams
articles.summary: A summary of what Roman Surzhikov has said about Polari in livestreams answering readers' questions: the conception of the series, the workings of its world, Objects and firstblood, its characters, unresolved mysteries, and unwritten interludes.
searchAliases: Слово автора — что Роман Суржиков рассказывал о цикле «Полари» на стримах

articles.title: Dreams of Francis-Ilian
articles.ru: The dreams of Francis-Ilian, the prophetic king Shimmery
articles.summary: The nine prophetic dreams of King Francis-Ilian of Shimmery: from the first, about the world's destruction in the Bottomless Abyss, which led him to relinquish power and enter a monastery, to the ninth, featuring a crucified man and a burning finger. Some came true literally; others were interpreted differently by the prophet and his listeners. After the victory at First Winter, he declared that all had been fulfilled and took this as proof of the existence of ‘higher’ gods.
searchAliases: Сны Франциска-Илиана — вещие сновидения короля-пророка Шиммери

articles.title: Stratems
articles.ru: Stratemes — military board game of the nobility Polari
articles.summary: Stratems is a military board game, a favourite pastime of Emperor Adrian, Erwin Origin, and Mira. Its pieces symbolise the social estates, and skill at the game is considered a sign of a commander's intelligence. According to the Guide, the Stratems master Reidan Adler founded the Origin dynasty.
searchAliases: Стратемы — военная настольная игра знати Полари

articles.title: Arrow, Coin, Spark (Book within Polari)
articles.ru: “Arrow, Coin, Spark” as a book published and read in the world of Polari
aliases: Arrow Coin Spark in the World
A Novel in the World of Polari
articles.summary: Within the Collector's Edition's literary conceit, Arrow, Coin, Spark is a sensational novel in Polari about the Bridal Fair and the Northern Uprising. The capital's nobility praises it, its protagonists read it themselves, and Lady Karen comments on it for Lord N's expanded edition.
searchAliases: Стрела, монета, искра (книга в мире Полари)
«Стрела, монета, искра» как книга, изданная и прочитанная в самом мире Полари

articles.title: Radiant Sphere
articles.ru: Light Sphere (searcher)
articles.summary: A Sacred Object from the seventeenth Gift of the Gods, formerly belonging to House Shayland. It appears to be two transparent rings, one inside the other. In reality, the Sphere is a ‘finder’, locating other Objects and bearers of firstblood. Its sale, forgery, and wanderings tie together many of the series' storylines.

articles.title: Sacred Objects
articles.ru: Sacred Objects — shrines and property of Polari families
articles.summary: Sacred Objects are indestructible artefacts that enter the world with the Gifts of the Gods. They are noble lineages' most precious possessions, a measure of ‘divine favour’, and, in the eighteenth century, fearsome weapons. The end of the series reveals that Objects are surviving components of crashed starships.
searchAliases: Священные Предметы — святыни и достояние родов Полари

articles.title: Dark Ido
articles.ru: Dark Ido - Lord of Chaos
articles.summary: Dark Ido is the lord of chaos and the gods' chief enemy in Polari's faith. All evil is attributed to him, and his name appears in curses. Navi maintained that Ido truly exists and that Paul is his servant, able to use the Absolute as a key to open a portal and admit chaos into the world beneath the moon.

articles.title: Church
articles.ru: Holy Church of the Mothers and Forefathers
articles.summary: The Holy Church of Polari consists of two branches: the Foremothers' branch, governed by the archmother and a chapter of seventeen high mothers, and the Forefathers' branch, headed by the priarch. During the series, Gallard Almera held the priarchy; the Ecumenical Council stripped him of office in 1775, and after the war both branches were left without leaders.

articles.title: Quotations
articles.ru: Quotations and sayings from the Polari series
articles.summary: A selection of memorable lines spoken by characters in the Polari series—from ‘I am alive. I am clever. I am a spark’ to the series' final words, ‘The choice is yours’—together with proverbs, commandments, and sayings from Polari's world. The Russian source reproduces the quotations verbatim from the books.

articles.title: Ulyana's Dust
articles.ru: Ulyanina Dust - The subject of secret letters and coercion
articles.summary: A silvery, apple-shaped Object covered in pollen. Writing made with it can be read only by the person the writer pictured, and it robs an ordinary mortal of free will, compelling them to obey the written command. The Puppeteer used it against Manson, Nexia, and Iona.
searchAliases: Ульянина Пыль — Предмет тайных писем и принуждения

articles.title: Eternal Flow
articles.ru: Eternal Flow — Sacred Object of the Cathedral of Agatha the Radiant in the First Winter
articles.summary: A Sacred Object belonging to the Origins, kept in the Cathedral of Agatha the Radiant in First Winter. It is a ring of blue metal with a small light suspended inside. When placed at an angle, it does not fall but takes a week to settle slowly onto the altar.
searchAliases: Вечное Течение — Священный Предмет собора Светлой Агаты в Первой Зиме

articles.title: Eternal Hilt
articles.ru: Eternal Hilt - the sacred dagger of the Dynasty
articles.summary: A transparent, three-edged dagger-Object, symbol of the Illustrious Dynasty's authority, which leaves its sheath only at turning points in history. According to Navi, it is the most dangerous of the Objects, capable of absorbing and releasing heat. Navi used it to fight Paul in the Roe Deer Grotto.

articles.title: Balloon
articles.ru: Harmon's Balloon - Polari's Skyship
articles.summary: The ‘skyship’ of Hortensius, a stoker from Laem, bought and improved by Harmon: first a hot-air balloon, then the Double Sphere with a hydrogen balloon. The first vessel flew away over the Bottomless Abyss; the second, built by Harmon for the Origins, served as a decoy in the Battle for First Winter.
searchAliases: Воздушный шар Хармона — небесный корабль Полари

articles.title: Universal Spiral
articles.ru: The Universal Spiral - the device of the universe in the faith Polari
articles.summary: The image of the cosmos in Polari's faith: after wresting a realm of order from Dark Ido, the gods built the Universal Spiral coil by coil, with the world beneath the moon lying on one of its turns. Its sign is the sacred spiral, the Church's symbol and principal gesture of prayer. At the end of the series, Navi explains that the spiral is the galaxy.
searchAliases: Вселенская спираль — устройство мироздания в вере Полари

articles.title: Juliana's Law
articles.ru: Julian law (Julian code) — Imperial code of laws Juliana the Great
articles.summary: Juliana's Law, or Juliana's Code, is the empire-wide body of laws introduced by Empress Juliana the Great in the sixteenth century. It took account of the customs of every land in Polaris and remains in force during the series: it is cited in courts, in the Chamber, and in disputes over war, rebellion, and the Shepherds' Meadows.
articles.when: Sixteenth century after the Descent, after the Horse Wars
searchAliases: Юлианов закон (Юлианин кодекс) — общеимперский свод законов Юлианы Великой

articles.title: The Lands of Polari and the Real World
articles.ru: Lands and States of Polari in comparison with real countries and regions
articles.summary: A comparison of Polari's lands with real countries in climate, economy, political system, and customs. The author has not named direct models. The Guide to the Lands of Polari contains several comparisons with our world: First Winter's climate is comparable to Moscow's, Shayland is called ‘Polari's Albion’, and Folta resembles Athens. The article's other parallels are observations, each accompanied by its basis.
searchAliases: Земли и государства Полари в сравнении с реальными странами и регионами

articles.title: Railway
articles.ru: Rails and spark trains Polari
articles.summary: Railways with trains pulled by spark-powered engines connect Faunterra to Polari's largest cities. Emperor Adrian's dream of covering the entire Empire with rails, and the tax intended to pay for construction, set the series' events in motion; the trains themselves became instruments of war, conspiracy, and sabotage.
searchAliases: Рельсовые дороги и искровые поезда Полари

articles.title: The Star
articles.ru: A star is a luminary in the sky of Polaris, in fact a false lighthouse
articles.summary: The third luminary in Polaris's sky, where the people of Polari believe the souls of the dead go. At the end of the series, it proves to be an enormous Sacred Object: a metal wheel thirty-five miles across, a navigation beacon of the ‘gods’, reconfigured by saboteurs so that for centuries it has directed starships straight into the planet.
searchAliases: Звезда — светило на небе Полариса, в действительности ложный маяк

articles.title: Battle of Pixie
articles.ru: Battle of Pixie (2 December 1774, Day of Descent)
articles.summary: A battle of the Northern Uprising in which Alexis Smile's spark-equipped army defeated the forces of Origin and Northwood near the town of Pixie in the Southern Way. Erwin's flight from the battlefield proved to be a ruse that allowed him to capture Faunterra, and the defeat itself served as bait for the trap in Labelin.
articles.when: December 2, 1774 (morning of the Day of Descent of the Mothers)
searchAliases: Битва при Пикси (2 декабря 1774 г., День Сошествия)

articles.title: Capture of Faunterra
articles.ru: The Siege of Faunterra and the Siege of the Palace of Pen and Sword (6–28 December 1774)
articles.summary: The capture of the imperial capital by six hundred northerners under Erwin Origin, who arrived by train after their feigned flight at Pixie, followed by a three-week defence of the Palace of Pen and Sword against Major Beckfield's troops, ending in peace between Erwin and Empress Minerva.
articles.when: night from 6 to 7 December 1774 (capture); siege until 28 December
searchAliases: Взятие Фаунтерры и осада дворца Пера и Меча (6–28 декабря 1774 г.)

articles.title: Battle for First Winter
articles.ru: Battle for the First Winter (December 2, 1775, Descent Day)
aliases: the Battle of the First Winter
Battle of the Valley of the First Winter
articles.summary: The decisive battle of the series, in which the Origins, Minerva, and Nathaniel defeated Vittor Shayland's army beneath the walls of First Winter. Paul died in the battle; on the following night, Richard killed Desmond Origin and was himself slain by Erwin.
searchAliases: Битва за Первую Зиму (2 декабря 1775 г., День Сошествия)

articles.title: Wedding of Iona and Vittor
articles.ru: Marriage of Lady Iona Sophia Jessica Origin and Count Vittor Keilin to Agna Shayland, March 1774.
aliases: the Marriage of Vittor and Iona
The Marriage of Shayland and Origin
articles.summary: The wedding of Duke Desmond Origin's daughter and the banker-count Vittor Shayland in First Winter in the spring of 1774. The enormous bride price and the unequal standing of the two parties made it a symbol of the Origins' poverty, while the marriage itself later led to enmity, captivity, and a trial.
articles.when: end of March 1774 (about a week after March 22)
searchAliases: Бракосочетание леди Ионы Софии Джессики Ориджин и графа Виттора Кейлина Агны Шейланда, март 1774 г.

articles.title: Expedition beyond the River
articles.ru: Erwin Origin's Exploration in the Beyond (April - August 1774)
articles.summary: In 1774, Erwin Origin's father sent him on an explorada into the Beyond to find a site for a spark-powered dam on the River. Beyond the River, the expedition discovered the previously unknown resting place of the Eighteenth Gift and was massacred by soldiers in red shirts. Only Erwin and the kair Jemis survived; what they saw there drove the Origins to rebel against the emperor.
searchAliases: Эксплорада Эрвина Ориджина в Запределье (апрель — август 1774)

articles.title: Minerva's Coronation
articles.ru: Coronation of the Empress Minerva Gemma Alessandra of the Yangmei family
articles.summary: Minerva's accession to the throne after Adrian's death and Origin's victory in the Northern War: a lavish ceremony orchestrated by Lord Chancellor Erwin Origin.
searchAliases: Коронация императрицы Минервы Джеммы Алессандры рода Янмэй

articles.title: Beck Train Disaster
articles.ru: The collapse of the imperial train on the bridge over the Back
articles.summary: The fall of Emperor Adrian's train from a collapsing bridge over the River Beck on 22 December 1774, after which the emperor was believed to have been murdered by the jester Manson and Origin's war with the Crown could be brought to a peaceful end. It later emerged that Adrian had survived.
searchAliases: Крушение императорского поезда на мосту через Бэк

articles.title: Horse Wars
articles.ru: Horse Wars (First, Second, and Third)
articles.summary: Three wars of the sixteenth century in which Shavan hordes from the West invaded the central lands of the Empire. The first was led by Ganta Darian (Darian the Foul). The wars ended under Empress Juliana the Great, who established the Empire's borders and made the Shepherds' Meadows common territory.
articles.when: Sixteenth century after the Descent (three wars)

articles.title: Sale of the Radiant Sphere
articles.ru: Secret sale of the Bright Sphere to the Duke of Labelin (deal with a fake)
articles.summary: A secret transaction in 1774. Acting for Count Vittor Shayland, the merchant Harmon sold the Radiant Sphere to Duke Labelin for 36,000 hilts but handed over a forgery made by Maximian monks. He tricked his way into recovering the original and took it south. It later emerged that Paul himself had devised the sale as a trap for Navi.
articles.when: April - July 1774 (deal in the bank - June 27, 1774; return of the original - July 4, 1774)
searchAliases: Тайная продажа Светлой Сферы герцогу Лабелину (сделка с подделкой)

articles.title: Mill War
articles.ru: The Mill War (War of the Mills, 1773)
articles.summary: Count Rantigar's campaign from the Sunset Coast into the disputed lands of the Mills in the summer and autumn of 1773. Rantigar took four castles, but the Millers wore down his army, and First Winter sent kairs to their aid; the count surrendered without a final battle. The mercenary Joaquin Eve Hannah began his service in this war.

articles.title: Jemis's Rebellion
articles.ru: Jemis Lilliday's Cairo Conspiracy against Erwin Origin in the Soft Fields (May 1774)
articles.summary: An unsuccessful attempt by the explorada's kairs, led by Jemis Lilliday, to remove Erwin Origin from command by force. Erwin crushed it by standing bare-chested before the ringleader and stripped Jemis of his cloak.
searchAliases: Заговор кайра Джемиса Лиллидея против Эрвина Ориджина в Мягких Полях (май 1774 г.)

articles.title: Northern Uprising
articles.ru: Northern Outbreak - Duke Erwin Origin's rebellion against the Emperor Adrian (1774)
articles.summary: The war of the Great House Origin against Emperor Adrian in the autumn and winter of 1774, launched by Erwin after the events in the Beyond and the destruction of Evergard. It ended with the capture of the capital, Adrian's apparent death, and peace between Erwin and Minerva.
articles.when: End of August - End of December 1774
searchAliases: Северная Вспышка — мятеж герцога Эрвина Ориджина против императора Адриана (1774)

articles.title: Attempt on Mira's Life
articles.ru: Poisoning of Minerva Stagforth at the Northwood House (June-July 1774)
articles.summary: In the summer of 1774, Countess Sybil Northwood, with the involvement of Priarch Gallard Almera, spent about two weeks poisoning Mira's coffee while passing off the effects as an illness. Their aim was to dispose of the real Minerva Stagfort and make Sybil's daughter Gloria the emperor's bride. Mira uncovered the plot, secured her life by threatening suicide, and was imprisoned in the cave convent of Saint Ulyana.
searchAliases: Отравление Минервы Стагфорт в доме Нортвудов (июнь — июль 1774)

articles.title: Coup in Waymar
articles.ru: Lady Iona Origin's attempt to capture Waymar Castle and arrest her husband, 27 May 1775.
articles.summary: Iona Origin and her northerners' night attack on the garrison of Waymar Castle, intended to arrest Count Vittor Shayland—the Puppeteer. The castle was almost taken, but a Finger of Wilhelm in the hands of the barber Harry Hogg turned the tide. Iona surrendered, and her kairs were slaughtered despite the count's oath.
articles.when: 27 May 1775 (about 10 p.m.) and the night of 28 May
searchAliases: Попытка леди Ионы Ориджин захватить Уэймарский замок и арестовать мужа, 27 мая 1775 г.

articles.title: Fall of Evergard
articles.ru: Destruction of Evergard Castle by Wilhelm's Feathers
articles.summary: A night attack by a force armed with Wilhelm's Fingers on the citadel of the Dukes of Almera, killing Duke Aiden and his son; it provided the occasion for Origin's rebellion.

articles.title: Night in Labelin
articles.ru: Night Labelin - the defeat of Alexis Smile's army in Labelin (early December 1774)
articles.summary: A night attack by five northern battalions hiding in Labelin's catacombs against Alexis Smile's spark-equipped army, which was quartered in the city after its victory at Pixie. The Crown's army was destroyed, and the captured northerners were freed.
articles.when: Early December 1774, shortly after the Battle of Pixie (exact date not specified)
searchAliases: Ночной Лабелин — разгром армии Алексиса Смайла в Лабелине (начало декабря 1774 г.)

articles.title: Seventeenth Gift
articles.ru: Seventeenth Gift of the Gods (1756)
articles.summary: The Gift of the Gods that arrived in 1756 in the forests of Shayland near Waymar: a forest fire, the Sunsetters' seizure of the resting place and Desmond Origin's campaign, celebrations in Waymar, the mystery of the dead ‘goddess’ in a transparent coffin, and Paul's appearance.
articles.when: August 1756 (Waymar celebrations); Dar himself had come a few months earlier

articles.title: Jesters' Conspiracy
articles.ru: The Jokes: Manson Louise's Failed Coup (1755–1756)
articles.summary: The Jesters' Conspiracy was an attempted coup undertaken around twenty years before the start of the series by Manson, Emperor Tellurian's younger brother, with the backing of the Great House Lightheart. Duke Aiden Almera exposed the plot. The conspirators were executed, House Lightheart was destroyed, and Manson was made the court jester.
articles.when: about 1755–1756 ("twenty years ago" in 1774; letter of Captain Corvis dated October 19, 1755)
searchAliases: Шутовской заговор — неудавшийся переворот Менсона Луизы (1755–1756)

articles.title: Descent of the Foremothers
articles.ru: The descent of the Mothers (the descent of the Ancestors) — the beginning of the history and chronology of Polari
articles.summary: The Descent is the arrival of the holy Foremothers and Forefathers in the world beneath the moon, from which Polari reckons its calendar and which it celebrates every year on 2 December. According to scripture, the Forebears emerged from the Underground Kingdom and spent their first winter in the valley of First Winter; the end of the series reveals that this was the landing of survivors from a crashed starship.
articles.when: year 0 years; holiday - December 2 (Day of Descent)
searchAliases: Сошествие Праматерей (Сошествие Прародителей) — начало истории и летоисчисления Полари

articles.title: Trial of Manson
articles.ru: Meetings of the Supreme Court of the Empire of Polari in the case of Lord Manson (May 1775)
articles.summary: The public trial of the jester Manson for Adrian's murder; it ended with the exposure of Ulyana's Dust, the admission that Adrian was alive, and the defendant's acquittal.
searchAliases: Заседания верховного суда Империи Полари по делу лорда Менсона (май 1775 г.)

articles.title: Standoff at the Holy Field
articles.ru: Confrontation on the Holy Field (Spring 1775)
articles.summary: A battle planned by Erwin Origin between the northern army and the rebel Snowdrops, which never took place: at the last moment, Minerva pardoned the peasants and sent them home.

articles.title: Tournament at Aleridan
articles.ru: Knight's Tournament at Damon the Great's Arena in Aleridan (summer 1773)
articles.summary: A three-day knightly tournament held by Duke Aiden Almera in the summer of 1773. Its unexpected champion was the unknown Sir Loren of Hope, who dedicated his victory to Lady Alanis. It is known through the merchant Harmon's account.
searchAliases: Рыцарский турнир на арене Дэймона Великого в Алеридане (лето 1773 года)

articles.title: Snowdrop Rebellion
articles.ru: The Snowdrop Rebellion (Salem's march from Summerswith to Faunterra)
articles.summary: A mass march on the capital by starving peasants of the Southern Way and townspeople of the Crownlands in the winter and spring of 1775. It ended with Empress Minerva's pardon of the rebels at the Holy Field, followed by some of the former insurgents entering Adrian's service.
searchAliases: Восстание Подснежников (поход Салема из Саммерсвита на Фаунтерру)

articles.title: Second Northwood War
articles.ru: Second Northwood War
articles.summary: A war against Northwood, apparently fought by House Origin, mentioned only once in the series. During it, the Origins acquired extensive pastures in the west of the duchy, which they subsequently traded to the Lillidays for full control of the Gates of Heaven.

articles.title: Ambush at Lacey
articles.ru: The massacre of Reis' ambassadors at Lacey's estate
articles.summary: Negotiations between the Litlands and ambassadors from the County of Reis in August 1774, ending in a treacherous attack on the envoys over dinner. Count Damir Reis was killed; Moran Steppe Fire escaped and rallied the West to war against Litland.
searchAliases: Резня послов Рейса в поместье Лейси

articles.title: Golden War
articles.ru: The Golden War (circa 1750)
articles.summary: A war in the mid-eighteenth century in which the powerful House Lightheart attacked Almera and seized part of its territory. The emperor did not intervene, and Almera was saved by the Origins, who came to its aid. The decisive engagement was the Battle of Breimel Bridge.

articles.title: House Almera
articles.ru: The Great House of Almera, of Agatha's lineage
articles.summary: A Great House descended from Agatha the Radiant, which ruled the richest duchy in the Empire; it was almost entirely exterminated in 1774–1775.

articles.title: House Farway
articles.ru: The Great House of Farway, Dukes of Hope
articles.summary: The ruling house of the Duchy of Hope, which rose to prominence after the Jesters' Conspiracy; during the wars of 1774–1775, it skilfully manoeuvred between the opposing sides and took Almera for itself.

articles.title: House Labelin
articles.ru: The Great House of Labelin
articles.summary: A wealthy Great House of Sophia's lineage, ruling the mercantile Duchy of the Southern Way. Its coat of arms includes dolphins and sheaves of wheat. For centuries, the Labelins grew rich through trade with the North but lost wars; in 1775, they recovered their lands and gained power through Magda's marriage to Adrian.

articles.title: House Lightheart
articles.ru: The Great House of Lightheart, former Dukes of Hope
articles.summary: An ancient lineage descended from Elena, which ruled the Duchy of Hope for centuries. The house lost power after the Jesters' Conspiracy: Duke Jonas and his two eldest sons died on the scaffold, his daughter Karen disappeared into imprisonment for twenty years, and the surviving youngest son, Edgar, retained only Leongard and took the name Flame.
searchAliases: Великий Дом Лайтхарт, бывшие герцоги Надежды

articles.title: House Litland
articles.ru: The Great House of Litland
articles.summary: A Great House descended from Yanmei, ruling the southern Duchy of Litland; known for its ‘web’ of pigeon post, its perpetual feud with the Shavans of Reis, and the ambush at Lacey.

articles.title: House Northwood
articles.ru: The Great House of Northwood, Counts of Northwood
articles.summary: A northern Great House, the Counts of Northwood, descended from free archers and pirates of Foremother Susan's lineage; its symbol is the bear and its colour is green.

articles.title: House Origin
articles.ru: The Great House Origin, descendants of Agatha the Radiant
articles.summary: The Great House of the northern Duchy of Origin, descended from Foremother Agatha the Radiant; it rules from First Winter and is renowned for its invincible kairs. Much of the series centres on its members: Erwin, Iona, Desmond, and Richard.
searchAliases: Великий Дом Ориджин, потомки Светлой Агаты

articles.title: House Shayland
articles.ru: The Great House of Shayland, Counts of Shayland
articles.summary: The weakest and most ‘lowborn’ of the Great Houses, ruling a narrow county along the River Torrey, with a dynasty descended from merchant bankers. Under Count Vittor, the house became the Puppeteer's lair.

articles.title: The Yanmei Dynasty
articles.ru: The Illustrious Dynasty of the Lineage of Yanmei the Merciful
articles.summary: The ruling imperial house of Polari, descended from Foremother Yanmei the Merciful; by the end of the series, Adrian and Minerva are its two claimants to the crown.

articles.title: Greys
articles.ru: Greys — the grey-cloaked apprentices and servants of kairs
articles.summary: Greys are the apprentices, servants, and soldiers of House Origin's kairs, distinguished by their grey cloaks. After several years of service and passing a trial, a grey may receive a kair's bicoloured cloak; those who do not pass form the backbone of the northern infantry.
searchAliases: Греи — ученики и слуги кайров в серых плащах

articles.title: Kairs
articles.ru: Kairs — the knightly warrior estate of the North
articles.summary: Kairs are northern warrior-knights in the service of House Origin, wearing bicoloured red-and-black cloaks; they are considered the finest swordsmen in Polaris. Their elite are the X-cloaks, who wear black cloaks bearing a diagonal cross.

articles.title: Snowdrops
articles.ru: The Snowdrops — the peasant army of Salem of Summersweet
articles.summary: The name adopted by the army of peasants and townspeople who marched on Faunterra in search of justice during the winter and spring of 1775; their symbol was a snowdrop tied to a spear. Minerva pardoned them at the Holy Field, but some later became Adrian's mercenaries.
searchAliases: Подснежники — крестьянское войско Салема из Саммерсвита

articles.title: The Protection
articles.ru: The Protection — the emperor’s secret guard
articles.summary: The Crown's secret police, established by Emperor Tellurian after the Jesters' Conspiracy; its head is known as the ‘Raven of the Crown’.

articles.title: Gardeners
articles.ru: The Gardeners — the secret order cultivating the Great Tree
articles.summary: A secret order said to have been founded by four Forebears, which for seventeen centuries has guided Polaris towards the ‘Great Tree’ through the advancement of science. At the end of the series, Navi explains that the order's true goal is to reach the beacon Star and change its signal.

articles.title: Shavans
articles.ru: Shavans — riders of the Great Steppe
articles.summary: Mounted nomads of the Great Steppe beyond the River Hollywell, inhabitants of the free counties of Reis and Hollywell. Their horde, led first by Moran Steppe Fire and then by Paul (Pus-Ganta), devastated Litland, Almera, and the North in 1774–1775.

articles.title: Great Houses
articles.ru: The Great Houses of the Empire of Polari
articles.summary: The Great Houses are the thirteen most noble lineages of Polari, each possessing more than twenty Sacred Objects. They rule the lands of the Empire and vote in the Chamber of Representatives. Their rivalry with the Crown and with one another is the principal driving force of politics in the series.

articles.title: Sunsetters
articles.ru: Sunsetters — the people of the Sunset Coast and the cult of the Fallen One
articles.summary: The name given to the inhabitants of the Sunset Coast, descendants of rebellious slaves. Among them arose the cult of the Fallen One: worship of a dead Foremother found in the resting place of the Seventeenth Gift, involving ritual consumption of the dead. Its spiritual leader is General Horis (Oris), whose army fought for Vittor Shayland in 1775 and departed after Paul's death.
searchAliases: Закатники — народ Закатного Берега и культ Павшей

articles.title: Aleridan
articles.ru: Aleridan, capital of the Duchy of Almera
articles.summary: Almera's capital, a wealthy brick-built city with a university, spark-powered tramcars, and fountains; Evergard Castle stands on its outskirts. The city was occupied by the troops of Hope in 1775.

articles.title: Duchy of Almera
articles.ru: Duchy of Almer (Red Land)
articles.summary: The richest duchy in central Polaris, the domain of House Almera: some fifty elegant cities, brickworks and red-clay quarries, spark workshops, and an aristocratic spirit. In 1774–1775, it became the setting for war, Priarch Gallard's intrigues, and the horde's invasion, after which Henry Farway took possession of it.

articles.title: Beck
articles.ru: The Back River and the Rail Bridge over it
articles.summary: A fast-flowing river in eastern Almera, a tributary of the Hollywell, with the Arrowback castle-dam. The railway bridge across it collapsed beneath Adrian's train in 1774, and he was then believed dead. In 1775, the river formed the boundary between Almera and the Crownlands.
searchAliases: Река Бэк и рельсовый мост через неё

articles.title: Belomorye
articles.ru: Belomorye — port of the Counts of Fleming
articles.summary: A port city on the northern coast of the Duchy of Origin, beside the Sea of Ice; the ancestral domain of the Counts of Fleming, who repeatedly rebelled against the Origins. In 1775, Belomorye went over to the Puppeteer.

articles.title: Bottomless Abyss
articles.ru: The bottomless chasm (the bottomless failure) in the mountain lions Shimmery
articles.summary: A gigantic chasm in Shimmery's Lion Mountains, overlooked by the Maximian Monastery by the Abyss. No one had seen its bottom, and the Church prohibited descents. The Radiant Sphere showed Harmon a black lake with lights at the bottom. At the end of the series, it is revealed to contain the wreckage of the starship on which the Foremothers arrived, and one of the First Tree's three ‘roots’.
searchAliases: Бездонная Пропасть (Бездонный Провал) в Львиных горах Шиммери

articles.title: Blackmore
articles.ru: County and City of Blackmore
articles.summary: One of the Duchy of Almera's three counties and its major city, the domain of the Counts of Blackmore. Count Blackmore, who had served Duke Aiden for twenty years, betrayed the wounded Alanis Almera in 1774 and became her bitterest enemy; his nephew, Colonel Daniel Blackmore, died in 1775 during the northerners' war against the priarch.

articles.title: The Twins
articles.ru: Twins - the Upper and Lower Twin Rivers
articles.summary: Two small rivers on the Trade Road marking the border between Origin and the Southern Way, with a border station on the narrow strip of land between them. Erwin Origin crossed the Twins to invade the Southern Way in 1774. At the end of 1775, General Horton's corps—five Origin battalions and a regiment from Hope—landed on the Upper Twin behind Adrian's lines.
searchAliases: Близняшки — реки Верхняя и Нижняя Близняшка

articles.title: Darkwater
articles.ru: The Kingdom of Darkwater
articles.summary: A marshland kingdom in southwestern Polaris, beside the Ocean of the Abyss, homeland of cribola stingers, poisons, and witchcraft. Its people are few, closely united, and the most insular in the Empire; it is also Empress Ingrid's homeland. It was ruled by the blind Lady in the Dark of the Lords Nen-Clair, a master of the Order of Gardeners. In Fantasies, after her death, her exiled daughter Mireille takes the throne.

articles.title: Doyle
articles.ru: City of Doyle
articles.summary: One of the Southern Way's largest cities, in the west of the duchy beside Smoky Distance, with the impregnable fortress of Upper Doyle on a hill. In October 1774, Erwin Origin took it without a storming assault by executing more than twenty captured townspeople; this act became the most painful memory of his war.

articles.title: Palace of Pen and Sword
articles.ru: Palace of Pen and Sword - Imperial residence in Faunterra
aliases: the Palace of Pen and Sword
articles.summary: The marble palace of the emperors of Polari on an island in the middle of the Khanai in Faunterra, the Illustrious Dynasty's residence since Juliana the Great. The setting of imperial balls and audiences, captured and held under siege by Erwin Origin in December 1774.
searchAliases: Дворец Пера и Меча — императорская резиденция в Фаунтерре

articles.title: Smoky Distance
articles.ru: Lake Smoky Dahl
articles.summary: An enormous freshwater lake in central Polaris, shrouded in perpetual haze. It serves both as a trade route and a natural barrier between Shayland, Almera, the Southern Way, and other lands; the rivers Hollywell and Torrey flow from it.

articles.title: Jack Buckler
articles.ru: "Jack Buckler"
articles.summary: The Jack Buckler is the Buckler brothers' forest inn in Arrowback County, three miles west of the settlement of Roadpost. Its owners served the Puppeteer's brigade. In December 1774, the inn burned after a massacre carried out by Ice; only Inzhi Price, Little G, and a newlywed pair of deserters escaped. Its ashes became a key to Mark's investigation.

articles.title: Arrowback
articles.ru: Arrowback County and Arrowback Castle (Back)
articles.summary: A county in northeastern Almera and its castle-dam on the River Beck: a fortified spark-generating workshop, Almera's second-strongest fortress. Adrian's train crashed nearby, and the cautious Count Arrowback became an ally of Alanis and Erwin.

articles.title: Evergard
articles.ru: Evergard, citadel of the Dukes of Almera
articles.summary: The ancestral castle of the Dukes of Almera, on a hill outside Aleridan. Destroyed by Wilhelm's Fingers in 1774, it was rebuilt by Priarch Gallard and became his residence.

articles.title: Faunterra
articles.ru: Faunterra, capital of the Polari Empire
articles.summary: The oldest city in the world beneath the moon and the capital of the Empire of Polari, on the River Khanai; the residence of the Yanmei Dynasty and the setting for the series' principal political events.

articles.title: Finborough
articles.ru: Free City of Finborough
articles.summary: A small free city in the Southern Way on an inlet of the Khanai, home to weavers, riverfolk, and fishermen, whose spark workshop belongs to the baronial brothers Devo. The setting of ‘Routine Business’ in Fantasies: in the summer of 1776, the dog Biter was tried here and sentenced to death, while the lawman Macfreed Crow solved Baron Bernard Devo's murder.

articles.title: Fliss
articles.ru: City of Fliss
articles.summary: A wealthy lake port in the north of the Duchy of Almera, on the shore of Smoky Distance, called ‘Almera's principal lake gateway’, and headquarters of the Fighting Brotherhood of Wilhelm. In the summer of 1775, the northerners defeated Priarch Gallard's army near Fliss. In late July, Paul's horde reached the city, and Paul killed Mother Cordelia at its gates.

articles.title: Folta
articles.ru: Republic of Volta (Foltia Islands)
articles.summary: An island republic west of Darkwater, outside the Empire of Polari. A state of seafarers, traders, and disputants, with ‘equal rule’ instead of a single ruler and a belief in Polaris's coming division. Mireille Nen-Clair lived here in exile for ten years.

articles.title: Roe Deer Grotto
articles.ru: The Grotto of Kosuli - a cave-holiest in the First Winter
aliases: Agatha in the grotto of the roe
articles.summary: A cave on the slope of Agatha's Peak above the valley of First Winter, where, according to legend, Agatha the Radiant spared a snow-white roe deer and emerged into the fertile valley. The Agathan order's holiest shrine. On 2 December 1775, in its underground chapel, Navi lured Paul into the deconstructor's strike.
searchAliases: Грот Косули — пещера-святыня у Первой Зимы

articles.title: Riverbend
articles.ru: Izluchina city
articles.summary: A small town in the Northern Crownlands at a bend in the River Khanai, controlling the only ferry crossing for a hundred miles. Here Harmon received Count Shayland's letter and took in refugees from the Blue-Grey Plague, Joaquin met Polly, and Father David spoke with Harmon twice. In 1775, the Snowdrops defeated the army sent by Tax Minister Dreyfus Born outside Riverbend.

articles.title: Khanai
articles.ru: The Hanai River
articles.summary: The largest river in the Crownlands, flowing through Faunterra to Mason Bay. The capital, Riverbend, and Arden stand on its banks, and river vessels ply its waters. In December 1774, its water and ice became the battlefield for the Palace of Pen and Sword.

articles.title: Hollywell
articles.ru: Holy River Halliwell (and County Halliwell)
articles.summary: The greatest river on the continent, flowing south from Lake Smoky Distance to the ocean; sacred to the Shavans and a boundary between the Steppe and the central lands. The same name belongs to a free county in the West, with its capital at Corden, where water and the Drop-God are worshipped.

articles.title: Bear's Fang
articles.ru: The Bear Fang, the capital of Northwood County
articles.summary: The capital of Northwood County and the Northwoods' ancestral castle: a wooden city with a port and the North's largest shipyards, beside a river in the midst of deep forest.

articles.title: Crystal Mountains
articles.ru: Crystal Mountains - the mountain range of Origin on the isthmus between Polaris and the Beyond
articles.summary: A mountain range in the northeast of the Empire. It covers the narrow isthmus connecting Polaris to the Beyond and occupies about forty per cent of Origin's territory. According to legend, the Foremothers spent their first days in the world beneath the moon here, making the mountains the foremost holy destination for pilgrims. Erwin Origin's explorada crossed them in the spring of 1774.
searchAliases: Кристальные горы — горный хребет Ориджина на перешейке между Поларисом и Запредельем

articles.title: Labelin
articles.ru: Labelin City
articles.summary: The capital of the Duchy of the Southern Way and seat of House Labelin. An enormous, unwalled city of the wealthy on the railway to Faunterra, the world's second-most-populous city. In 1774–1775, it changed hands twice, both times without street fighting.

articles.title: Laem
articles.ru: White Stone Laem
articles.summary: The white-stone capital and chief port of the Kingdom of Shimmery, Prince Hector's domain. A city of teahouses, bridges, and altessas, where episodes involving Harmon's skyship, Magda Labelin's negotiations, and Jemis Lilliday's courtship unfold.

articles.title: Leed
articles.ru: Leed - the ancient capital of the North, the city of the Counts of Lilliday
articles.summary: A stone city on a plateau in the Crystal Mountains, ancestral seat of the Counts Lilliday and the ‘ancient capital of the North’, older than First Winter. Famed for its armourers, ordzh, and the Leed Wolves. In November 1775, it surrendered to the Chosen One without a fight, was handed over by Martin Shayland for Paul's Shavans to plunder, and was liberated by Iona and Erwin.
searchAliases: Лид — древняя столица Севера, город графов Лиллидей

articles.title: Fox Vale
articles.ru: Foxy Dole, a town and barony in Northwood County
articles.summary: One of Northwood's largest cities, Countess Sybil Northwood's birthplace. In September 1775, it opened its gates to the army of the ‘Chosen One’, Vittor Shayland; in early October, Desmond Origin and Craig Northwood lost the decisive northern battle nearby.
searchAliases: Лисий Дол — город и баронство в графстве Нортвуд

articles.title: Litland
articles.ru: Duchy of Litland
articles.summary: A southern duchy of the Empire of Polari on the eastern coast, the domain of House Litland: a land of jungles, spices, and the Empire's most cheerful people. It borders Reis along the River Hollywell and became a battleground in the war against Moran's horde in 1774–1775.

articles.title: Marengo
articles.ru: Marengo
articles.summary: The Crownlands' second-largest city, the wealthiest port on the coast of the Far Sea, and the emperors' summer residence, with the Palace of Silence. It is known here as the ‘emperors' refuge’.

articles.title: Melison
articles.ru: Melison, town of winemakers in Shimmery
articles.summary: A quiet winegrowers' town in a secluded mountain valley beside the White Road, two miles beyond the Little Pass. In the autumn of 1774, Harmon, under the name ‘good Horam’, bought the old estate of the Barons Monat-Erlin here. Master Hortensius built the hydrogen balloon here, and in May 1775 the ‘Heavenly Sphere’ departed from here for the Bottomless Abyss.

articles.title: The Mills
articles.ru: County Mills (Mills Lands)
articles.summary: A western land on the Ocean of the Abyss coast north of Reis, successor to the slave-owning Empire of the Iron Sun. A union of three coastal cities—Fairis, Minnis, and Ofert—with Mother Mills and graveyards of Rusty Giants. In 1773, it repelled Count Rantigar with the kairs' help; in 1775, Erwin Origin's force departed north through Fairis.

articles.title: Melorange
articles.ru: Melorange, capital of the Duchy of Litland
articles.summary: The capital of the Duchy of Litland, on the edge of the ‘rope forests’, besieged in 1774–1775 by the western horde of Moran Steppe Fire.

articles.title: Sea of Ice
articles.ru: The Ice Sea - Polaris North Sea
articles.summary: A cold sea off the Empire's northern shores, bordering Origin, Northwood, and Shayland. It is the northerners' trade route, the Northwoods' pirating ground, and the domain of the Counts of Fleming. In the autumn of 1774, Fleming's flotilla sailed across it towards the River; in 1775, Count Fleming entrenched himself on its coast against the Origins.

articles.title: Hope
articles.ru: The Duchy of Hope
articles.summary: A vast, arid duchy in the centre of the continent, with prairies, gold-bearing streams, and a poisonous desert. Formerly the domain of the ancient House Lightheart, it has belonged to the Farways since the Jesters' Conspiracy. Its capital is the impregnable fortress of Heart of Light.

articles.title: Niar
articles.ru: City of Niar
articles.summary: One of the Crownlands' large cities, devastated by the Blue-Grey Plague in the spring of 1774, and Polly's hometown. Tax collectors later ruined it, and in the spring of 1775 the entire city supported the Snowdrop Rebellion.

articles.title: Northwood (County)
articles.ru: Northwood County
articles.summary: The forested northern county of the Great House Northwood, homeland of the ‘bears’: woodcutters, hunters, shipbuilders, and former pirates. It lies between Shayland and Origin on the Sea of Ice. The Puppeteer's army passed through it in 1775, and Desmond Origin and Craig Northwood were defeated at Fox Vale.

articles.title: Lands of Origin
articles.ru: Duchy of Origin (North)
articles.summary: A northern duchy of the Empire of Polari, the domain of the Great House Origin: mountains, rolling meadows with millions of sheep, silver and iron mines, and the cold coast of the Sea of Ice. Homeland of the kairs and the ‘holy place’ of Agatha's Descent, it became the principal theatre of war against the Puppeteer in 1775 and then the location of the Empire's new capital.

articles.title: Faraday-Riley Island
articles.ru: Faraday-Riley Island, Faraday and Riley Hospital
articles.summary: A small island in the Sea of Mason with an old fort housing a semi-secret asylum for the mentally ill—in practice, a convenient place for nobles to dispose of unwanted relatives. Sybil Northwood, Karen Lightheart, and Navi were held here.
searchAliases: Остров Фарадея-Райли, лечебница Фарадея и Райли

articles.title: The Shoal
articles.ru: City of Otmel
articles.summary: The city where the imperial mechanic Louis Maria was born. Harmon saw a Sacred Object in its cathedral, and Burke left an unfavourable memory of himself there. Which territory the city belongs to is unknown.

articles.title: Elena-by-the-Lake Boarding School
articles.ru: Pension Elena-u-Lake - a closed school for noble girls in the foothills of the Crystal Mountains
articles.summary: A secluded girls' boarding school beside a tiny mountain lake in the foothills of the Crystal Mountains, under House Origin's lordship. Reputedly the Empire's best school for brides, it teaches noble daughters the art of ruling, rather than manners, over four years. Iona Origin, Alanis Almera, and Gloria Northwood studied here; in 1774, a portrait in its hall of fame enabled the Raven of the Crown to uncover the substitution of brides.
searchAliases: Пансион Елены-у-Озера — закрытая школа для благородных девушек в предгорьях Кристальных гор

articles.title: First Winter
articles.ru: The First Winter: The Duke of Origin
aliases: the Valley of the First Winter
articles.summary: A city and castle in a northern mountain valley, the ancestral seat of House Origin. According to legend, the Foremothers spent their first winter here. In 1775, Minerva moved the Empire's capital here, and the series' decisive battle took place beneath First Winter's walls.

articles.title: Pixie
articles.ru: City of Pixie (Duchy of the Southern Way)
articles.summary: A tiny town in the Southern Way, forty miles south of Labelin, formed by joining two pottery villages. Joaquin was conscripted into the militia here in November 1774, and the Battle of Pixie took place nearby on 2 December 1774.

articles.title: Imperial Citadel
articles.ru: The Citadel, the old residence of the emperors at Faunterra
articles.summary: The Imperial Citadel is an ancient castle shaped like a granite cube on a hill in Faunterra's upper town. For seven centuries, it housed the rulers, then became a prison and repository for the Dynasty's Sacred Objects. The northerners captured it in December 1774, but the vault proved empty. In Fantasies, the Citadel belongs to Maurice Labelin and houses the Womb containing Vittor.
searchAliases: Престольная Цитадель — старая резиденция императоров в Фаунтерре

articles.title: Reis (County)
articles.ru: Free County Flight
articles.summary: A Shavan steppe county on the western coast, west of the Hollywell, with its capital at Rei-Roy. A land of herders, horse breeders, and slave traders, homeland of Moran Steppe Fire and the house of the Counts of Reis. The great horde, and then Paul's horde, emerged from here in 1774–1775.

articles.title: The River
articles.ru: The river is a great nameless river
articles.summary: The River is an enormous unnamed river in the Beyond, roughly three hundred miles past the Crystal Mountains. Beyond it, Erwin Origin's explorada discovered the resting place of the Eighteenth Gift and a secret fort containing Wilhelm's Fingers. Erwin's oath to destroy everything beyond the River foreshadowed the Northern War.

articles.title: Heart of Light
articles.ru: Heart of Light, capital of the Duchy of Hope
articles.summary: The ancient capital of Hope and the Empire's strongest fortress: a city of one hundred thousand people surrounded by three belts of fortifications, taken only once, after a year-long siege in the sixteenth century. Formerly a Lightheart possession, it has been Duke Henry Farway's residence since the Jesters' Conspiracy.

articles.title: Shayland (County)
articles.ru: County of Shayland - Preforestation and Porechye
articles.summary: The northern county of the Great House Shayland: a narrow strip of fertile land along the River Torrey from Smoky Distance to the Sea of Ice, a misty country of bankers, barge haulers, and brewers. The Seventeenth Gift arrived here in 1756, and the Puppeteer's conspiracy came to fruition here in 1775.

articles.title: Six-Mile Wood
articles.ru: Six-mile forest (northeast of Almera)
